tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa'i rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi cho ga'i las rim 'chi med 'byung ba'i nyin byed ltar bdud rtsi'i dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'od zer dri med cho ga tshe 'byor sta gon sogs tshang ma dpe 'di nang mthus// 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'chi med 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ dpal shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor las/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags kyis/ /tsha zer 'phros pas 'gro ba yi/ /sdug bsngal mun pa sel la 'dud/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams spel ba dang / /dus min 'chi ba bsal ba'i phyir/ /'od zer dri med rnam dag pa'i/ /gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bri/ /'dir 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi gzungs las dkyil 'khor bya bar gsungs la/ de'i cho ga rgyas par ma gsungs la/ spyi rgyud las/ gang du las ni yod gyur la/ /rang gi las kyi cho ga med/ /de ni mkhas pa'i spyi rgyud las/ /gsungs pa'i las rnams bya ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ spyi rgyud la brten nas kha bskangs te brjod par bya'o/ /de yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /gang zhig legs par dbang bskur ba/ /de ni rigs rnam gsum car gyi/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs slob dpon 'gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur ba/ /de ni rim gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon du ni dbang bskur 'gyur/ /phyag na rdo rje'i gzi byin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur ba/ /de ni rdo rje rigs gcig gi /dkyil 'khor gyi ni slob dpon 'gyur/ /zhes pa bzhin dbang thob la ma nyams pa bsnyen byed tshul 'og thig tshon gyi skabs na gsal pa sngon du song bas/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i sar/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i dbang du byas na gnas khang byi dor byas/

dkon mchog gi rten gsum mchod pas brgyan pa/ slob dpon gyi mdun du/ mdzes pa'i stegs bu slob dpon gyi g.yon nas 'go brtsams pa'i mchod pa bzhi/ de'i nang du g.yon nas rim bzhin bsang chu 'thor g.yab bcas pa/ rdor dril dang spos/ ba byung / dri bzang sogs kyang ji ltar 'os par bkod/ sgrub grogs rnams kyi mdun du'ang / rdor dril/ rnga sil dkar dung sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa bkod legs mthong bas yid 'phrog pa bsham/ gso sbyong blangs la thog ma sa chog gi bdag dang gnas bsrung ba ni khu tshur bcangs te/ the'u chung gnyis bshibs te bsgreng / mdzub mo rtse mo sbyar ba'i glor mthe bong gnyis btsugs pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā pa la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+wan+satwa uts+tshaṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas khro bo mnol ba med pa'i sngags rgyas bdag nyid bsrung bar 'gyur/ rang gi snying khar zla ba la rnam snang gi sa bon ma/ mgrin pa 'od dpag med kyi sa bon maṃ/ mgo bor mi bskyod pa'i sa bon ha 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrigs par gyur/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swā bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ rang bzhin gyis dag par gyur/ phyir phyung ste so shing bca' ba la sogs pa dang / lha khang gi byi dor la sogs pa bya/ bshang gci che chung dang zan za ba'i tshe/ khro bo mnol ba med pas bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas khrus kyi phyir skye bo 'du ba dang ya nga ba med pa'i 'jug ngogs su song ste lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo phyi rol du bsnol te bkug nas mdzub mo gnyis bshibs te bsgreng / mthe bong gnyis de'i drung du bzhag pa'i phyag rgya sa gtsang ma la gtug ste/ oṃ ni kha na ba su dhe swāhā/ zhes bzlas te/ sa blangs la cha gsum du bgos te gnas gtsang mar bzhag go /de nas mthe bos/ mthe chung gi sen mo mnan la/ sor mo lhag ma rnams bar nas gang tsam phye ste/ rdo rje'i mtshan nyid du byas te bsnol la dpung par bzhag ste/

ya sos ma mchu mnan la khro bo'i blta bas blta zhing mkhur sa bus te/ rkang pa g.yas brkyang du byas la/ oṃ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā nā ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pā ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgyas bsrung bar byas par gyur/ 'og tu bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgya zhes par sngags 'di yin/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgya zhes par sngags 'di brjod cing phyag rgya 'di 'ching ngo / /khu tshur gnyis nang du bcings te mdzub mo phyung nas bsgrengs te/ des mgo nas rkang pa la thug gi bar du brab cing / oṃ ha na ha na a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas lus kyi bgegs bsal bar gyur/ thal mo bkan pa las/ mthe chung gnyis bsnol ba'i bar du srin lag gnyis bzhag gung mo gnyis bshibs te bsgreng la/ de'i tshig gsum par mdzub mo bkug ste/ mthe bong gnyis sbyar nas dbus su bzhag pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra ag+ni pra dī pa ta ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i rdo rje'i go cha bkon par gyur/ phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis bskyed nas rdo rje'i tshul du byas pa rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya dang / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ hūm̐ kha ki li hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas phyag rgyas mgo bo dang / dpung mgo gnyis dang / snying ka dang mgrin pa rnams su go cha gyon par gyur/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo dbus ma gnyis mthe bos mnan la mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung gnyis gdu bu'i tshul byas te sor mo dbus ma'i tshigs dbus mar gzugs/ lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo dbus ma gsum rdo rje'i tshul du byas te bskor bas bzhag pa bgegs bsal ba'i phyag rgya dang / na mo badz+ra ya hūm̐ ha na dhu na ma tha bhi dh+wan+pa ya ud pa ra ya phaṭa/ zhes chu la sngags btab nas chu'i bgegs bsal bar gyur/

na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsan+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra ṇa ha/ zhes pa'i sngags chu la gdab/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung gi sen mo mnan la sor mo rdo rje'i mtshan nyid byas pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ kī li kī la badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i sngags rgyas/ chu la gtugs te sa la gsang gtor byas par gyur/ 'og tu kī li kī la'i sngags rgya zhes pa rnams 'di'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra ha ra hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun bzlas la sa'i cha gcig blangs te/ chu nang du lte ba nub tsam du phyin la khrus ras dang bcas pas khrus bya'o/ /de la sa'i cha lhag mas lag pa bkrus te lag pa g.yas pa'i thal mo bkan pa las mdzub mo mthe bo'i drung du bzhag ste/ mthe bo yang mdzub mo'i tshig dbus mar byas par dbyangs can ma'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ shru ti smṛ ti dha ri ṇi hūm̐ ha/ lag pa g.yas pa thal mo brkyang ste mdzub mo dbus ma gnyis cung zad bkug pas mchu la reg nas kha la byabs/ rna ba gnyis/ mig gnyis/ sna kha/ lag pa gnyis/ mgo bo lte ba la reg pa lan bcu gsum bya/ kha lan gsum bshal/ chu lan gnyis dor ba ste nye reg go /de nas oṃ su sid+dhi ka ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags kyis gtsug phud bcings la bsrung bar byas par gyur/ de nas sa blangs te/ oṃ bhu dza la hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bsngags nas g.yas nas bskor te/ nyi ma la bstan nas lus la bku'o/ de nas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pa na ye ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo rat+na badz+ra kro dha ya/ ma hā diṣ+ṭhata ka ra bhe ra bā ya ta ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nan/ bi na ya kān ma hā ga na pa ti dzi bi ta ap+ta ka ra ya swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags dang lag pa g.yas pa'i thal mo bkan pa las/ gung mo dang srin lag bkug ste/ mthe bos rtse mo nas mnan/

mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung cung zad bkug pa/ chur dkrug pa'i sngags rnams chu dkrug par gyur/ oṃ ra te ra te bhud+dha ya swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis chu khyor ba gsum dkon mchog gsum la dbul bar gyur/ de nas/ oṃ a mṛ ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis rang gi mgo bor chu snyim pa gsum blug go /de nas bdud rtsi'i bsang / sngags 'don bzhin pas gci bas khrus bya'o/ /don zhags yid ches khung btsun las/ skabs 'ga' zhig du/ 'byung lnga'i nye reg bya ste de nas/ chu gtsang dang sa gtsang du sbyar bas byed pa khyad par ro/ /de bzhin du ba lci'i nye reg bya ste zhes pa dang / dri chu'i nye reg bya ste/ zhes 'byung ba nang chu la ba lci btab pa dang / grib pa bya ste/ des tshul ni 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs/ khrus zin pa dang lag pa bkrus te/ gsang sngags de nyid kyi chu snyim pa gsum gyi bdag nyid la dbang bskur bar gyur/ de nas rang gis lha nyid yid kyis spyan drangs te pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ta a mṛ ta swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis sku khrus gsol bar gyur/ de bzhin gong du na maḥsap+ta naṃ nas/ hu ru hu ru swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin nyer gcig bzlas nas langs te gos gyon rim gyis lha'i khang pa'i drung du phyin par gyur/ rkang pa bkrus te nye reg byas nas lha khang du zhugs par gyur/ lha rnams mngon sum du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra pra ṇa me na sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pā da naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas phyag bya/ khrus 'di rnams skye bo 'du ba dang ya nga ba med pa'i 'jug ngogs su dngos su song nas bya ba grub na rab/ de nas 'byor na bsgrub khang gi phyi rol du cho ga byed cing yan lag lnga khrus byas nas nang du 'jug pa'i cho gas 'jug de yang ma grub na don zhags yid ches khungs btsun las/ rgyan dngos dang khams ngan pas dri chab kyi bum pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i chus khrus kyi sngags nyer gcig brjod nas gdong dang rkang lag bkru ba tsam la'ang bsdu ru rung ngo zhes gsungs so/

/dam tshig la 'jug pa'i sngags 'di bzla'o/ /oṃ bi ra dza bi ra dza/ ma hā badz+ri/ pa ta pa ta/ pā ra ta pā ra te/ tra yi tra yi bad+dhi ma ni saṃ bhañja ni ta ra ma ti sid+dha a gre taṃ swāhā/ de nas oṃ traṃ bun+dha swāhā/ zhes pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi las thams cad yang / bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags bdun gyis spos chu byin gyis brlabs/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor ni rigs gsum pa'i las sngags rang bzhin te spyi rgyud las/ las rnams kun la rab tu grags/ /khro bo bdud rtsi thabs sbyor ni/ /rigs sngags gsum dag spyi la yang / /bgegs rnams thams cad bzhom pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba sa yi bdag pos bshad/ /ces bshad pas sngags de gnyis bzla zhing spos chu 'thor g.yab kyis bdag la gtor nas/ bdag nyid kyi bgegs bsal bar gyur/ oṃ traṃ ban+dha swāhā/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags dzi na dzika 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi snying po yin/ spyir/ dzi ṇa dzika de bzhin gshegs pa'i/ a ro lika pad+ma'i/ badz+ra dh+rika rdo rje rigs kyi snying po yin no/ /lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ so so'i rigs pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i/ mchod yon/ dri chab/ me tog mar me/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas kyi bye brag ji snyed yod pa thams cad/ rang bzhin stong pa rnams mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas so sor snang ba ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung ltar bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ bla ma dang 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa'i rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/

su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ārta ya ho/ oṃ s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtog pa dang bcas spyi bzhin/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe chung gi sen mo mnan la/ sor mo lhag ma gsum bsgreng la kī li kī la'i phyag rgya/ de las rdo rje thal mo/ de las mnyam pa'i thal mo byas pa mchod pa spyi'i phyag rgya mchod pa re re'i phyag rgya'i sngon du 'gro ba'i mthe'u chung dang srin lag nang du phan tshun bsnol ste/ gung mo bshibs te bsgrengs pa'i tshigs gsum par mdzub mo gzug mthe bong ngos la sbyar ba mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ lag pa g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya'i mkhrigs ma nas lag pa g.yon pa bzung ba dri'i phyag rgya dang / ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ sngags 'di mar me ma gtogs gzhan bzhi la'ang 'dra'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo phan tshun bsnol te/ lag pa'i nang du mdzub mo gnyis phan tshun rtse mo gcig tu byas la gdu bu'i tshul du byas nas/ mthe bong glor bzhag par pad+ma ltar byas pa me tog phyag rgya dang / ā ha ra sogs lag ma gnyis kyi mthe'u chung dang srin lag dang gung mo rnams kyi sor mo rnams phan tshun sbyar te/ snga ma snga ma'i rgyab kyi sen mo'i drung du bkug nas mdzub mo gnyis logs shig tu brkyangs te mthe bong gnyis glor bzhag pa gdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang / ā ha ra sogs/ zed pa'i thal mo las mdzub mo cung bkug pa lha bshos kyi phyag rgya dang / ā ha ra sogs mthe bong dang gung mo gnyis gcig tu sbyar te bsgreng / lag pa g.yas khur tshur gcig tu byas pa mar me'i phyag rgya dang / ā lo ke ya/ ā lo ke ya bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ rol mo 'bud bkrol bya zhing / oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ dang / mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod/ spyan 'dren gyi mchod yon ma gtogs mchod yon dang rol mo rnams kyang phyag len la mdzad do/

/sngar gyi bgegs bsal ba'i phyag rgya las/ g.yon pa'i gung mor lag pa g.yas pa'i rdo rje bzung ba gzi byin bskyed pa'i phyag rgya me tog la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi steng du brims la/ oṃ te dzaḥte dzaḥs ni sid+dhi sā dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i mchod rdzas rnams lha rdzas kyi yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab par gzi byin bskyed par gyur/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgya byas la byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ dzi na dz-ika brtan par gyur/ thal mo sbyar te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa dus 'di nas bzung ste/ nam byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku zhi ba bla na med pa so so rang gi rig pa la skabs su mchi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes ci nus dang / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /bdag dang gzhan don bsgrub slad du/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gson/ /bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir/ /deng nas byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgos su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ nam byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dang / gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa chos bdag med pa mnyam pa'i phyir/ rang gi sems thog ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid du ji lta ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang sems bskyed do/

/zhes lan gsum brjod/ skyabs sems 'di bzhin bya/ rgyud kyi gzhung chen rnams dang mthun gsungs/ spyi 'gros kyang 'thus so/ /de nas gnas bsrung ba'i phyir bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom ste/ oṃ kī li kī la badz+ri badz+ri bhurban+dha hūm̐ zhes spos chu la lan bdun bzlas te/ phyogs kun tu bsang gtor byas la gnas bsrung bar gyur/ de nas lag pa gnyis kyi gung mo dang srin lag phan tshun gdu bur byas te/ so so'i drung du rtse mo sbyar mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo bshibs te bsgrengs/ mthe bo phur bu'i tshul du byas te sa la btsugs pa phur bu'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ kī li kī li badz+ri badz+ri bhurban+dhu hūm̐ gi bar gong bzhin brjod la/ bgegs rnams la phur bu'i gdab par gyur/ de nas oṃ su sid+dhi ka ra dz+wa li ta/ a nan+ta/ mut+ta ye/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes bzlas pa'i bdug spos kyis bdug la steng gi lha rnams bcings par gyur/ dzi na dzika mdun gyi spos chu la bzlas 'thor g.yab kyis phyogs thams cad du gtor/ bh+rūṃ rig pa'i rgyal po'i sngags zhes pa 'di yin/ oṃ a mṛ tod+bhā wor+bha wa hūm̐ phaṭa/ rig pa'i rgyal po rta mgrin yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bcu 'di yin/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañcan+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐/ gh+rih+ṇa gh+rih+ṇa hūm̐/ gh+rih+ṇa pa ya gh+rih+ṇa pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā ra dza hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis phyogs kyi bgegs thams cad bcings par gyur/ rig pa'i rgyal po hūm̐ bzhi pa 'di yin te/ spyi rgyud las/ rgyal ba'i rigs la rig sngags rgyal/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i yi ge gcig /pad+ma'i rigs la rig sngags rgyal/ /rta mgrin yi ge bcu pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rigs la rig sngags rgyal/ /de bzhin gnod mdzes mthu bo che/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni bzhi dang ldan/

/zhes gsungs pas so/ /de nas sngar gyi phur bu'i phyag rgya nyid las mthe bong gnyis gyen du bsgrengs ba rwa ba'i phyag rgya dang / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañcatsan+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sa ra sa ra/ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i phyogs brgyad po thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba'i go mtshams med par bskor bar gyur/ rwa ba'i phyag rgya nyid kha thur du bstan nas bskor ba drwa ba'i phyag rgya dang / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañcan+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ oṃ baṃ s+pha rak+ṣa badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i rdo rje rwa ba'i steng nas rdo rje'i drwa ba ste/ rdo rje'i gur bres par gyur/ sngar bzhin bdud rtsi thabs sbyor dang / kī li kī la badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags rgyas brtan par byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ de nas khu tshur bcings pa'i mthe bos sen mo rnams mnan te mdzub mo phyung nas dbus nas lan gsum bskor ba mtshams bcad pa'i phyag rgya dang / na maḥs man+ta badz+ra ṇi/ oṃ ta ra ta ra/ tu ru tu ru/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ sarba tra a pra ti ha te sa si me sa ma ban+dha/ ku ru ku ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa man+ta badz+re sa man+ta badz+ra/ ku ru/ a ma le/ kā ru ṇa/ ma ye ru ta ye ru ta ye/ ba ra ba ra/ ka ra ka ra/ su mi ma sa man+ta/ si dhan+pa ye dza la ya swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngar gyi rwa ba'i phyogs thams cad me dpung 'bar bas khebs par gyur/ zhes mtshams bcings so/ /de nas bgegs bsal ba dang / 'bags pa'i skyon spangs pa'i phyir/ spos chu lag mthil du blug la/ dzi na dzika zhes bzlas te rang gi spyi bor bsang gtor byas la bdag nyid sbyangs bar gyur/ de ltar bdag dang gnas bsrung la/ de nas ba'i rnam lnga la sngar bshad pa'i khro bo oṃ kī li kī la badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa sngags rgyas bsangs gtor bya/ de'ang spyi rgyud las/ khro bo kī li kī la yis/ /zhes pa'i rnam lnga la bzlas pa'i/ bsang gtor byas na sbyangs bar 'gyur/

zhes pa bzhin ba byung la bzlas te dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir gtor/ rkang pa g.yas pa sa la bzhag ste/ g.yon bteg pa'i bol gyis g.yas brkyang ba'i brla la bzhag la/ lag pa g.yas pa bsnun pa'i tshul du nga rgyal gyis brtan par byed pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ hu lu hu lu tsan+ḍa le ma taṃsga swāhā/ zhes pa gzhan gyi mi thub pa'i sngags rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba ta thā ga ga ne dā d+ya ā na/ ba lo ki ṭa badz+ra ma ra badz+roṣ+ṇi ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ pradz+nyā mi ta mūrta swāhā/ lag pa gnyis snyim pa sbyar la srin lag gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis nang du bkug ste/ mdzub mo gnyis kyis mthe bong gnyis la 'khyud pa rdo rje gtsug gtor gyi sngags rgyas sbyangs la bskor ba la sogs pa dgos pa'i sa gzhi yin na/ seng ldeng pa'i phur bu mkhyus gang pa rno ba bzhi la tsan+dan dmar po bskus/ skud pa dmar pos dkris/ rdo rje phur pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ gnas kyi phyogs bzhir gdab ste las gyis pa dang bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags bzlas pa'i yungs dkar gyis bgegs bsal/ rig pa'i rgyal po'i sngags bzlas pa'i ba dan dkar po smyug ma ring pos yu ba byas pa shar du gzung / lcags phye la rdo rje rwa ba'i sngags rgyas bzlas nas rdo rje'i rwa ba bya/ rdo rje rwa ba'i sngags rgyas bzlas pa'i lcags phyes khor yug tu rdo rje phreng ba bris la rdo rje'i drwa ba bya/ bdud brtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgyas bsrung ba byas la de nas bskos te/ sa'i zug tu rnams bsal la zhib mor brdungs te/ ba yi gcin gyis bran nas sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam par byas la/ shar phyogs nas brtsams te ba lcis dbyugs dbus su khung bu bskos te 'bru lnga dang / rin chen lnga la las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis btabs la gzhug zug tu dbyung bar 'dod nus pa yod na/ las thams cad pa dang sangs rgyas spyan gyi bzlas shing lag pas brab par bya'o/

/gal te bsko ba la sogs mi dgos na sa gzhi byi dor byas la sa gter bcug ba byung dang dri bzang po'i chus byugs nas lag pas reg ste mdzub mo gnyis sbyar nas/ dkyil 'khor lta bur byas pa dang / oṃ badz+ra yaṣ+ṇi ṣā dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ban+dha ban+dha/ da ma da ma/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ha na hūm̐/ zhes pas rgyal ba'i gtsug tor ro/ /oṃ traṃ bhab+dha swāhā/ zhes las sngags bzlas te sa sbyang ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sa gzhi las sngags bzlas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sa gzhi dang lha gnas rnams su dri'i thig le me tog tshom bu/ phyi nang gi mchod gtor bya ba sogs 'og mdun bskyed skabs nas bshad pa bzhin bshams/ de nas rang gis ku sha'i rgyan la sogs pa stan gang yin la bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgyas bsang gtor byas/ ku sha'i stan la rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi 'khod par gyur/ de nas/ oṃ dhu na badz+ra ha zhes pa'i sngags kyis bsngags pa'i thog chog pa'i shing ngam/ dur khrod kyi 'gal dum la byas pa'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa bkrus/ tsan+dan dmar po bskus pa'am/ yang na rang gi rdo rje la legs par gyur byed/ e h+ye ni/ a ha ra sogs bzhi'i mchod/ oṃ dhu na badz+ra ha/ zhes lan bdun bzlas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du bzhugs te/ bdag gi las thams cad grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod nas/ de mchod pa la sogs pa byed na lag pa g.yon pas bzung bar bya'o/ /sbrang bu gsum sgril mdung pa gsum bor la/ dbus su bho dhi tse'i phreng ba rdog po gcig btags pa mkhrigs ma g.yon la gdag par gyur/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ne sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swāhā/ dzi na dzika bzlas pa'i ku sha'i bsangs byed srin lag g.yas gdag par gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃḥ sarba bud+dha/ a dhiṣ+ṭha tā ma tsī ba ra swāhā/ ze'u kha bcings par gyur/ de nas lus drang por bsrangs te gzhag la dbang po lnga yum gyi khyad par dag las bzlog te/

mgrin pa rma bya ltar byas pa sogs/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba dal bus dbyung zhing mig cung zad tsam phye ste/ sna'i rtse mor lta ba der gtod cing sos so mnan nas lce rkan la sbyar te/ sems can gyi tshogs ma lus pa la snying rje chen po bskyed nas byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas khams gsum po thams cad rnam par shes par tsam las gzhan du med cing rnam par shes pa de yang don dam pa'i rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa nam mkha' lta bur spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba stong pa nyid kun rdzob tu zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par gyur/ zhes bsgom pa ni stong pa nyid kyi lha'o/ /de nas langs nas/ na maḥsap+ta naṃ nas/ hu ru hu ru swāhā bar tshar gcig bzlas la/ zhes pa'i sgra grags par gyur/ zhes brjod pa ni sgra'i lha'o/ /de las sngags kyi yi ge'i rnam par nam mkha' gnas par gyur/ zhes brjod pa ni yi ge'i lha'o/ /de zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bskyed/ /de las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pa'i rtse la rang gi lha'i gzugs kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa spros/ de'i mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag med sprul nas/ 'phags pa thams cad mchod sprin chen po sprul pa las bdud rtsi'i char rgyun phab pas dmyal ba pa rnams bde bas tshims par byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzugs dang bcas 'od zer slar logs rang gi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la zhugs nas gcig tu gyur pa la bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bur/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i brgyan pa/ seng ge'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad par gyur/ zhes pa sogs nas gzugs kyi rdo rje'o/ /lag pa khu tshur byas te sor mo brkyang so so'i rtse mo rnams phan tshun du sprad de nang stong par byas pa gtsug tor gi phyag rgya dang /

oṃ druṃ bhan+dha swāhā/ zhes pas dbu gtsug tor dang ldan par gyur/ lag pa'i sor mo rnams phan tshun sbyar la/ lag pa gnyis bkan te mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo sbyar ba bzlog nas thur du bstan te/ dpral ba bzhag pa mdzod spu'i phyag rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo a ra ha te bh+yaḥ samyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥ he he ban+dha ban+dha tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ dha ra ya dha ra ya/ ni tun+dha ni tun+dha/ ur+ṇa ma ṇi swāhā/ zhes pas mdzod spu dang ldan par gyur/ thal mo phan tshun sbyar te gung mo rdo rje rtse mo ltar byas la/ de'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis cung zad bkug la bzhag mthe bong gnyis nang du chud pa'i spyan gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ ru ru s+phu ru bzlas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyan dang ldan par gyur/ thal mo sbyar ba byas khog stong ltar byas pa nor bu rin po che'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ te dzo dz+wa la sarba sā dha ka sid+dhī tsit+ta ma ṇi rat+na hūm̐/ zhes pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar gyur/ skyil mo krung gi g.yas g.yon brla'i nya'i phyogs su khu tshur rgyal mtshan du 'dzin/ 'khar gsil gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ dhu na tsit+ta ra ṇi hūm̐/ 'khar bsil dang ldan par gyur/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i phan tshun du mngon pa phyogs pa snam sbyar gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃḥ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhi tā ma tsi wa ra swāhā/ gong bzhin bzlas na snam sbyar dang ldan par gyur/ lag pa thal mo sbyar nas bzed pa ltar byas pa lhung bzed kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ lo ka pā la a dhiṣ+ṭhi tī gar dha ra ya ma hā busta ba nu dha pā tra swāhā/ lhung bzed dang ldan par gyur/ lag pa g.yas pa mthe bong btegs la/ khu tshur bcang / g.yon chos gos 'dzin dang chos gos kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ rak+na rak+na maṃḥ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha tād ma tsi wa ra swāhā/ gong bzhin bzlas nas chos gos dang ldan par gyur/ lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo phan tshun bsdams pa las g.yon pa'i mthe bong bteg pa mche ba'i phyag rgya dang /

na maḥs man+ta badz+ra ṇā+ai tiṣ+ṭha he tra ṭa trā ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ dz+wa la nā khi kha re/ tshems mche ba bzhi dang ldan par gyur/ lag g.yas pa'i mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa dang / g.yon pa'i skyabs sbyin pa'i mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yeḥ sarba mu khe bh+yeḥ sarba thā a ba sha ra dwa badz+ra marga nirda shwa ka swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi mi 'jigs pa dang ldan par gyur/ sngar gyi spyan gyi phyag rgya las gung mo'i tshigs bkug nas mdzub mo gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i byams pa'i phyag rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha mo tut+ga ta/ sarba sad twa hi tarka ka ra swāhā/ zhes pa byams pa'i thugs dang ldan par gyur/ sor mo rnams phan tshun bsdus nas khu tshur byas la/ gung mo gnyis bsgreng ba'i tshigs gsum par mdzub mo'i rtse mo bkug nas sbyar ba chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ ha na ha na/ tsakra rmista hūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo gyur/ lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo rdo rje'i rtse mo mar byas la mthe bo'i phyogs su bzhag la gnas pa'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ thal mo bkan la sbyar mdzub mo bkug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya snying ka dang / mgrin pa dang / smin mtshams dpung mgo gnyis te gnas lngar gtug oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ur+bha ba ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra ag+ni/ mthe'u chung bsnol bar srin lag bzhag gung mo bshibs mthe bong sbyar ba/ pra ti pa ta ye swāhā/ rdo rje'i go cha bkon par gyur/ de nyid mthe bong dang mdzub mo gnyis bskyed rdo rje'i tshul byas pa/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya oṃ hūm̐ kha ki li hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpung mgo gnyis snying ka dang mgrin pa rnams su go cha byas par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar go bkon pa'i sngags rgya sngar bzhin bya ba ni phyag rgya'i lha'o/ /de nyid la rnam par rtogs pa gzhan gyis ma g.yengs pa rnam rtog dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis de nyid yang dang yang du bsal bar gyur/

bdag bskyed do/ /yid ches khungs btsun las/ 'dir gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa las/ bdag nyid ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba dam pa med pa dang / zhes bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed med par bshad pa ni/ bya rgyud rkyang pa lha'i snyam pa med pa lta bu la dgongs nas yin gyi/ gtan zhes ma yin no zhes slob dpon byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa'i legs par grub pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa las bya ba'i rgyud las lha bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa la bstan to snyam du bsam pa mi bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis phar cher ma bstan kyang / phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba dang / de kho na nyid bcu la 'jug pa dag las gtso bo bstan to/ /gcig tu dngos grub thams cad ni/ gsang sngags gyi lha dang / de kho na nyid la rag lus pa yin la/ de dag rnam par nyams pa na zhi ba la sogs pa'i las rnams 'grub par mi 'gyur bas/ bla mas bshad pa dang rgyud kyi khyad par cung zad dpyad pa las khong du chud par bya'o/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /zhes pa bdag bskyed nas mdun du rin po che du ma las byas pa'i sa gzhi las gser gyi bye ma brdal bar gyur/ oṃ tsa la bī ra hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa de'i steng du 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po la/ nya lcib la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral ba/ pad+ma dang ut+pal la sogs pa'i me tog gis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i bya'i tshogs mang po lding bar gyur/ oṃ be ma la dhā hā hūm̐/ byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ de'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab gru bzhi pa ngos bzhi nas rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i them skas kyi phreng bas brgyan pa mtha' bskor du dpag bsam gyi shing legs par 'khrungs pa la rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan stong 'bur ba rang gi khyad par gyi rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ ri rab de'i steng du pad+ma'i sdong bu rin po che du mas brgyan pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'dab ma dang /

gser gyi ze'u 'bru dang ge sar gyis brgyan pa/ sbur long gi ze'u 'bru can/ snying po'i thog la dngul gyi ri mos bskor ba/ dpag tshad du ma'i khyon can/ ri rab kyi dbus brtol nas byung bar gyur/ de las kyang pad+ma'i drwa ba gzhan brgya stong bye ba snyed byung bar gyur/ pad+ma'i steng du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rin po che'i rtsig pa nang nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar/ dmar/ ser/ ljang / nag pa'i rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu/ drwa ba/ drwa phyed/ shar bu/ mda' yab la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyogs mdog dbus dkar/ shar dmar/ lho ser/ nub ljang / byang nag po/ phyi nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu'i kha khyer gyi bskor ba/ rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad phun sum tshogs pa/ ye shes kyi snang ba las grub par gyur/ phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo phan tshun bsnol te g.yas pa'i mthe bos g.yon pa'i mthe bo mnan pa'i phyag rgya bcings la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā naṃ/ sarbā thā ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan brgya sogs gang rung bzlas par de rnams brtan par gyur/ steng nas bla re la sogs pa'ang grub par gyur/ nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi shar dbus su gdan ser po gru bzhi pa'i steng du pad zla la na maḥsap+ta nam nas hūm̐ rū swāhā'i bar/ dzi na dzika pad zla'i steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa nas/ phyag rgya mdzad pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ zhal nub tu bstan pa/ de'i g.yon ngos lho phyogs su gdan gyi khri zlum po la pad zla'i steng nas/ na mo rat+na tra ya s+ya/ na maḥtsan+ḍa badz+ra pa ṇi s+ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ti s+ya/ na maṣatsaṇ+ḍa pra mar+dha na ya swāhā/ hi ri mi ri ti ri ṇi swāhā/ badz+ra dhṛka phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po shin tu mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na rnga yab/ g.yon rdo rje 'dzin pa/

khro bo'i lus kyi nyams la gnas pa/ de'i mdun nub kyi phyogs su gdan dkyil 'khor zlum po'i steng du/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi s+ya/ oṃ lo la tsakra ya swāhā/ khyab 'jug nag po lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas na 'khor lo dang dung / g.yon na be con dang ral gri thog pa/ nam mkha' lding gi gdan la bzhugs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par gyur/ dung ni khyab 'jug gi mtshan ma yin te/ rig pa mchog gi rgyud las/ 'khor lo dung dang be con dang / /ral gri dang ni phub mdung dang / /nam mkha' lding dang phyag rnams ni/ /phyag 'jug phyag rgya bdun po yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de'i g.yon bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du dkyil 'khor zlum po'i steng du/ oṃ pa shu pa ti ni la kaṇ+ṭha u ma sri ya swāhā/ drag po dkar po mgrin pa sngon po/ lag pa g.yas na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon ral gri thogs pa glang khyu mchog la zhon pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi s+ya/ oṃ bh+ra ma ra te ni swāhā/ tshogs bdag sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdig mdzub mdzad pa mdun du sgur ba dang / phyir dgyed pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /lha de gsum zhal shar du gzigs pa'o/ /shar gyi bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas byang phyogs su gdan zlum po la pad zla'i steng du oṃ dzi dzi dzi naṃ ga ti ya te de ni swāhā/ a ro lika 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ston ka'i 'dam bu'i mdog ltar dkar ba pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yon na pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ phyi'i snam bu'i grwa bzhir pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ de'i steng du spos chus bkang ba'i bum pa dkar po mgul 'ching kha brgyan dang bcas pa snam bu la bkod pa'i mchod rdzas rnams la oṃ traṃ ban+dha swāhā/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags bdun gyi bsangs chus bsangs lag pa g.yon par spos chu blug

g.yas pa'i 'thor g.yab kyis bsangs gtor bya zhing / dzi na dzika bdun/ sngar gyi gegs sel ba'i phyag rgya las/ g.yon pa'i gung mor tshig bar g.yas pa'i rdo rje bzung ba/ oṃ te dza te dza pa ṇi sid+dha pā dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes gzi byin bskyed pa'i sngags rgya/ mchod rdzas rnams lha rdzas kyis yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab par gzi byin bskyed par gyur/ las sngags bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ dzi na dzika brtan par gyur/ 'og tu mchod gtor bsang ba sogs byin rlabs gong bzhin/ zhes pa so so'i khyad par ma gtogs 'di bzhin no/ /rang spyan drangs pa'i phyir legs grub las rjes su maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i me tog dang / spos kyi chu ni gtsang ma yis/ /mchod yon go rim bzhin bshams nas/ /bdug spos kyis kyang rab bdug ste/ /lan bdun bzlas la mchod yon des/ /lha rnams dag ni spyan drangs so/ /zhes dang / spyi rgyud las/ mchod yon snod ni gser dngul lam/ /zangs sam shel lam nor bu'am/ /'ching pa dkar po las byas pa/ /shing ngam de bzhin rdo rje las/ /dung ngam lo ma kyong ba'am/ /nya lcib dag gam kham phor ni/ /gsar pa yan lag ma nyams pa/ /dag par byas la blang bar bya/ /der ni khro rgyal bzlas pa yi/ /me tog dag kyang bcug nas su/ /mnyam par bzhag ste dkyil 'khor gyi/ /gsang sngags lan bdun bzlas nas ni/ /snga ma bzhin du dri chu yi/ /mchod yon gus pas dbul bar bya/ /zhes sogs kyi don no/ /zangs la sogs pa'i mchod yon gyi snod du/ nas dang / 'o ma dang / me tog dkar po dang / til dang / ku sha dang / 'bras yos dang / dri bzang dang / chu gtsang dang sbyar ba'i mchod yon bshams nas/ de la bdug spos kyis bdug dzi na dzika bdun/ oṃ traṃ ban+dha swāhā bdun/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor bdun bzlas te spyan 'dren gyi mchod yon sgrub/ lha gnas pa'i phyogs sam/ ri mo la sogs pa lha'i gzugs bzhugs pa der kha bltas te sor mo phan tshun bsnol bas thal mo bkan la mdzub mo gnyis bshibs te bsgreng /

mthe bo gnyis g.yas pas spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshul gshegs bcom ldan 'dir/ /bdag gi mchod yon 'dir bzhes nas/ /mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /bh+rūṃ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma la bi sho dha ni tu dha ba le pra ti saṃ ka ra ta thā ga ta dha rū dha re saṃ dha ra sarba ta thā ga ta a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swāhā/ shākya mu ne a h+ye hi/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'di ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs kyis thugs dpag mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma la sogs gong bzhin gyi mthar/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pus mo sa la btsugs te/ mthe'u chung dang srin lag nang du phan tshun bsnol te bshibs te bsgreng ba'i tshig gsum par mdzub mo gzung / mthe bong ngos la sbyar ba mchod yon gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bcas nas shar gyi stegs bu'i steng du 'bul/ oṃ a mṛ tod+bha wod+bha ba hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi dzi dzi naṃ ga ti ya te de ni swāhā/ ar+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra a h+ye hi/ bde bar gshegs so nas/ dpag mdzad du gsol/ oṃ dzi nas/ swāhā/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ mchod yon snying ka nas byang gi stegs bu'i steng du 'bul/ na moḥrat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsan+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ oṃ suṃ bha nas/ bid+yā ra dza hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ na mo rat+na nas/ hi ri mi ri ti ri ṇi swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi e h+ye hi/ bde ba nas/ mdzad du gsol/ na mo nas/ ti rī ṇi swāhā/ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ mchod yon lte ba'i thad nas rdo rje'i stegs bu'i steng du 'bul/ na mo nas/ bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi s+ya/ oṃ lo la tsakrā ya swāhā/ biṣ+ṇ+ya e h+ye hi/ na mo nas/ tsakrā ya swāhā/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ na mo nas/ ra dza hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ pā shū pa ti/ nī la kaṇ+ṭha u ma pṛ ya swāhā/

rū tra e h+ye ni/ oṃ pa shū nas/ pra ya swāhā/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ ༈ na mo nas/ rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi s+ya/ oṃ bh+ra ma ra ti ṇi swāhā/ gdan e h+ye hi/ na mo nas/ ra ti ṇi swāhā/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ bum sgrub skabs/ de gsum mchod yon nub kyi stegs bu dbul/ de la kha phyogs de dang der lta zhing / lha langs pa la langs nas dang / 'dug pa la 'dug nas dang / bzur pa la bzur nas spyan drangs so/ /de nas/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ga ga na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas byon legs byas nas/ tshig 'di nyid 'don pa kha bsgyur te/ bdag la zhabs bsil bzhes nas kyang / /zhabs bsil/ oṃ ga ga na sa ma ye hūm̐ sogs sngags gong bzhin gyis phul bas zhabs bkrus par bsam/ lha mdun du bzhugs su gsol la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya las sor mo gsum rdo rje ltar byas pa/ rdo rje 'dug stangs kyis phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra ā pa ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje'i 'dug stangs kyis gdan phul bar gyur/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ ka ma la ye swāhā/ zhes pa dang / pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis gdan phul bar gyur/ phyag rgya de nyid las sor mo dbus ma gnyis gcig tu sbyar ba so so'i 'dug stangs kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra ka ma hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas dpa' bo'i 'dug stangs kyis gdan phul bar gyur/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyis rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyi na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas lha de rnams la gus pas phyag phul bar bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra pra ṇa me na sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wak+ka bhan+dha naṃ ka ro mi zhes gong bzhin/

mchod pa dbul ba'i phyir/ dang po mchod yon ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs sngags kyis/ /gsang sngags kun la dbul lo zhes/ /me tog spos chus bkang ba yi/ /mchod yon dag gi dbul bar bya/ /sangs rgyas pa la shar phyogs su/ /gsang ba'i bdag por bshad pa yi/ /gsang sngags rnams la lho phyogs su/ /cho ga 'di ni nub phyogs su/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rnams ni/ /kun la 'bul lo bzhes brjod cing / /phyi rol stegs bu'i steng du mchod/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ mchod yon rnams kha gsos/ de bzhin shar phyogs kyi mchod pa rnams bsangs ba sogs gong bzhin/ bde bar gshegs so nas/ dpag mdzad du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma la bi shwa dha ni tu dha ba le pra ti si ka ra/ ta thā ga ta dha tu dha re dha re/ saṃ dha ra saṃ dha ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi ti swāhā/ sogs snying po'i mthar/ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ zhes spyan 'dren skabs bzhin/ 'og ma rnams la yang mchod yon spyan 'dren skabs bzhin shes par bya/ sku khrus gsol bar bya ste/ ri mo la sogs pa me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la khrus gsol zhing / ma 'byor na gsol bar bsgom la thal mo bkan la mdzub mo rtse sbyar ba dang / mthe bong gi rtse sbyar ba khrus gsol ba'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ sarba badz+ra wa ta a tsan ti a mṛ ta swāhā/ rin po che'i bum pa spos chu dri zhim pos gang ba du mas spos chus sprin chen po'i sku khrus gsol bar gyur/ zhes bcus pa'i phyag rgyas dbul par bsam/ gang 'dir bcom ldan nas/ yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o/ /rnam dag skyon bral byang chub sems kyi dbyings/ /rnam dag skyon bral yon tan tshogs kyi gter/ /kun gyis phyag bcas bstod cing mchod pa'i gnas/ /bdud bzhi dpung rnams ma lus tshar gcod phyir/ /chos dbyings dag pa'i sku la khrus chab gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/

gsung dang thugs la 'don pa spos/ bde gshegs sku gsum dpe dang mtshan lnga yang / /'gro ba'i don du gzugs sku ci yang gda'/ /rin chen dbyig ltar nyes pa'i skyon bral yang / /'jig rten srid zhu gus pa'i tshul tsam du/ /sdig med rgyal ba rnams kyis rab sngags pa'i/ /ras mchog 'di yi rgyal ba'i sku phyis pas/ /nyon mongs dug gsum sgrib pa kun byang nas/ /sku gsum ngang du bdag cag 'grub par shog /oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ zhes ye shes pa nas/ oṃ sarba ra tso a di ra ṇa swāhā/ zhes brjod/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur cig /spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser bzang btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra gab+dhe swāhā/ zhes sam/ a ha ra sogs dri'i sngags/ lha rdzas las grub kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim yid 'ong ldan/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra wasatra se swāhā/ bde gshegs sku mdog mtshan dang dpe byad dang / /rin chen 'od chags 'bar bas sku brgyan cing / /byang chub phyogs kyi rgyan gyis mdzes lags kyang / /'jig rten bkur sti rim gro'i tshul tsam du/ /rin chen phreng ba so mo do shal dang / /rgyan gyi dam pa khyad par mchog 'bul bas/ /byang chub phyogs kyi rgyan dang ldan gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra a lang ka ra wa su ṣa ni swāhā/ de ltar sku khrus gsol ba'i tshig bcad mkhan po bo dhi sa twas mdzad pa'i dri med mchod chog las/ sngags spyi 'gro byug pa'i tshig spyod 'jug las/ na bza' dang rgyan 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pas skong na legs shing / ma byas kyang chad skyon med pas gtso bo'i mchod pa dang po la khrus rgyas pa/ gzhan thams cad bsdus pa bya/

khrus sogs rgyas pa kha skang na na bza' rgyan gsol de kas 'thus/ khrus bsdus pa byed na/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra wasatra ya swāhā/ pi waṃ gying bu zangs dung dang / /dung dang rdza rnga rnga bo che/ /rol mo'i khyad par stong phrag bcu/ /snyan pa'i sgra yis rab tu mchod/ /oṃ badz+ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ yon tan rgya mtsho sogs 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod pa ni bsdus pa'o/ /rgyas pa'i tshe/ pi waṃ gling bu rnga sgra dang / /lha yi rnga chen mu rañja/ /rgyud mang gser gyi gling bu'i phreng / /glu gar rtsed 'jo rol mo yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod pa bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ rol mo 'bul bkrol bya/ yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos mchod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la/ /nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /mchod rdzas la dmigs te/ na maḥsap+ta naṃ sogs rtsa sngags tshar gcig gtsang zhing gtsang ma sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i dri 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /mchod pa spyi'i phyag rgya sngon du 'gro ba'i/ a hā ra sogs dri'i sngags rgya/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di/ /bdag gi dad pasྎ /bzhes nasྎ /spyi phyag dang / me tog gi sngags rgya/ nags tshal bcud ni yid du 'ong / /dri yi sbyar ba lha yi rdzas/ /bdag giྎ /bzhes nasྎ /spyi phyag dang / spos kyi sngags rgya/ sman rnams bcud ni yid du 'ong / /sngags kyi mkhur ba bcud 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ de bzhin du mkhur ba'i gnas su/ shing tog sran tshod/

'o thug ces bcug spyi phyag dang / de bzhin sngags rgya zhal zas bzhin/ gdon rnams 'joms shing bkra shis pa/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel 'di/ /bdag giྎ /bzhes nasྎ /ā lo ke ya ā lo ke ya sarba bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ spyi phyag dang / mar me'i sngags rgya/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal sel byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ rol mo 'bul dkrol bya/ slar yang shar phyogs kyi mchod yon sogs mchod pa kha gsos bsang ba sogs byin rlabs gong bzhin/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar/ yang mchod pa gsos gsang ba sogs byin gyis rlabs nas/ rol mo'i bar ste gtso bo la sum 'gyur gyis 'bul/ de yang rigs so so la mchod rdzas so sor dgos pa la bod du de mi snang cing / rigs gzhan gyi mchod rdzas gzhan la 'bul na rang gis sngags kyis btab nas dbul bar bshad pa bzhin du bya/ me tog dang bdug spos la sogs pa'i snod gcig las med na lha gcig la dbul ba tshar na yang bsangs gtor la sogs pa byas nas lha gcig gi sngags kyis byin brlabs byas nas 'bul/ zhes gsung yang byang phyogs kyi mchod pa bsang dzi na dzika gi'i tshab a ro lika ba sogs byin gyis rlabs/ bde bar gshegs so sogs spyan 'dren dus kyi mchod yon bzhin dang / mchod rdzas la dmigs rtsa sngags/ na maḥsap+ta naṃ sogs bzla ba'i dod/ oṃ dzi dzi sogs spyan ras gzigs kyi sngags bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ rol mo'i bar tshar gnyis/ yang lho phyogs kyi mchod pa 'di dang 'jig rten pa gsum gyi mchod pa gsar pa la badz+ra dh+rika bsangs ba sogs byin gyis brlabs/ bde bar gshegs so sogs spyan 'dren bzhin/ mchod rdzas sap+ta naṃ gyi tshab phyag rdor gyis sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ rol mo'i bar tshar gnyis/

'di gnyis kyi mchod pa rjes ma'i 'gor mchod yon sogs/ mchod pa thams cad kha gsos/ yang nub phyogs kyi mchod pa bsangs ba sogs byin gyis brlabs/ khyab 'jug gi sngags la ar+ghaṃ btags pa spyan 'dren bzhin gyi mchod yon mchod rdzas la/ na maḥsap+ta naṃ bzla ba'i tshab khyab 'jug gi sngags tshar gcig gi byin rlabs rol mo'i bar tshar gcig yang nub phyogs kyi mchod pa kha gsos nas bsangs ba sogs byin gyis rlabs/ rang sngags kyi mchod yon dang / na maḥsap+ta naṃ gyi tshab dang sngags brjod nas/ drag po la tshar gcig yang nub phyogs kyi mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis rlabs/ rang sngags kyi mchod yon/ na maḥsap+ta'i mthar rang sngags brjod de tshogs la tshar gcig phyogs bzhi mchod yon re bshams/ mchod pa gzhan phyogs re tshar re las snod ma 'byor na/ mchod pa bsang ba'i gong du mchod pa thams cad kha gso dgos so/ /de nas bstod pa bya ste/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pas 'dod chags bral bar gyur/ /dge bas ngan song las grol ba/ /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam thob pa/ /bslab pa dag par rab tu gnas/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun bsags pa/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs po che la drag shul che/ /rigs sngags rgyal po dge ba can/ /gdul dka' ba dag 'dul ba po/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha dog ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /mthu dang sde dang bzhon par bcas/ /thabs dang snying rje'i 'jig rten kun/ /skyongs mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bstod pa 'byung ba'i sngags/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa naṃ/ sarba tra saṃ ku ru mi tā a bi dz+nyā ra shaṃ ni na mo tu ye swāhā/

zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor nang du bshams pa'i gtor ma bsangs dzi na dzika sogs byin rlabs sngar bzhin las khyad par mchod rdzas rnams zhes par/ oṃ traṃ ban+dha swāhā/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor dang / dzi na dzika a ro lika badz+ra dh+rika lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du gtor ma rdzas kyi yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzi byin bskyed par gyur/ zhes bsgyur/ rdor thal gyen du kha phye mthar se gol gtogs pas/ biṣ+ṣu ru tra/ ga ṇa rnams re re'i mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grih+ṇe daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ btags pa gsum gyis dbul/ de nas/ sgrub khang gi phyi ru phyin la/ dpung bzang nas 'byung ba'i cho gas phyogs mtshams rnams gtor ma gsum dang / bgegs rnams la yang gtor ma sbyin no/ /gtor ma la mthong ba'i tshe lce spyang gi sgra'am/ sgra chen po'am 'brug sgra/ shing gi yal ga chags pa la sogs byung na gtor ma yang yang bskyar la sbyin zhing sngags bshad pa'i bsrung ba'i cho ga rnams bya'o/ /de nas lag pa bkrus nye reg bya ste/ dpung bzang las/ lus la sa yi dril phyis byas nas su/ /chu chen rnyog pa med par ltung nas kyang / /ji tsam 'dod pa'i bar du khrus byas te/ /byung na shar dang byang du kha bltas nas/ /chu des lag pa rkang pa bkrus nas su/ /pus mo phyi rol du ni bstan byas te/ /bar du log bzhag tsog tsog pa 'dug nas/ /sgra med lbu ba med pa'i nye reg bya/ /lan gsum bar du chu ni 'thung nas kyang / /tshul de lan gnyis yongs su phyi ba bya/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du/ mtsho chen dang ni babs chu'am/ /chu mig chu bo la gnas dang / /gtsang ma'i phyogs nas byung ba yis/ /sems can dag pa las blang la/ gnyis sam gsum du rtag tu yang / /sngags pas nye reg bya ba yin/ /de nas chu de gdong dang ni/

/de bzhin kha dang sna chog dag /mig dang rna ba lag gnyis dang / /spyi bo lte ba'i phyogs reg bya/ /dge ba spyad pas lan lnga'am bdun/ /cho ga bri bzhin thams cad bya/ /zhes pa sdom tshig tu mdzad par la/ kha dang mig rna kha lag mgo /lte ba rnams su gnyis gsum reg /ces so/ /slob dpon gyis rting mnan/ nang du log sgrub khang gi sgor/ spyi rgyud las/ khrus la sogs pa byed pa'i tshe/ /dkyil 'khor lte ba gzhan bzhag ste/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i tshe na ni/ /nam yang stong pa mi bzhag go /zhes gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bsrung ba'i sgrub grogs kyi bsangs chus bsangs spos kyis bdug nye reg sogs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan phyi rol tu 'byung po dang kha las byas pa'i grib sel ba yin pas/ dkyil 'khor bsrung ba'i tho'o/ /de bar sgrub khang gi phyir ma 'ong pa zhig dgos/ gdan la 'khod ste/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ ā ha ra ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+yā dha ra pu dzi te swāhāḥsogs/ spos kyi sngags brgya/ ā ha ra ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+yā ra dha ra pu dzi te swāhāḥsogs bshos kyi sngags brgya/ lha yi gtso bo rnams la ni/ /ras ni zung re zung re 'bul/ /sems dpa' chen po phal rnams la/ /ya re yang ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra wasatra ya swāhā/ gtso bo'i rtsa sngags dang snying po brgya rtsa/ lha gzhan rnams kyi sngags bdun re bzlas/ rigs spyi'i snying po/ dzi na dzika a ro lika badz+ra dh+rika gsum so sor brgya rtsa re bzlas so/ /spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bong phyir bskyed pa gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya dang / dzi na dzika gats+tsha/ a ro lika gats+tsha/ badz+ra dhṛka gats+tsha/ biṣ+ṭhā gats+tsha/ ru tra gats+tsha/ ga ṇa gats+tsha/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang / ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ spyan drangs pa'i lha gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ sngags kyi sprul pa'i dam tshig pa rnams rim gyis bdag la thims/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhas sa bzung ba'o/

/oṃ traṃ bhab+dha swāhā/ bh+rūṃ/ gnas 'dir 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa'i rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya'o/ /blos bzung ba ste sa bzung ba'i cho ga'o/ /sa bzung ba dang sta gon zhag gis bar chod na bdag bskyed rnal 'byor bsdu ba ni/ bdag gi lha'i gzugs zla ba'i steng gi yi ge la thims/ yi ge zla ba la thims/ zla ba rnam smin gyi lus la thims par gyur/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa bkan pa'i steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo bzhag te sor mo bsnol ba'i tshe rtse mo grung bar bya ste/ thal sbyar gdams pa mi mnyam pa'i thal mo'am/ phyogs drug g.yon phyogs nas bskor zhing / oṃ hu lu hu lu tsaṇ+ḍa li ma taṃ gi swāhā/ zhes brjod la sngags kyi rwa ba dang / drwa bas phyogs mtshams bcings pa la sogs pa grol bar gyur pa/ thal mo bkan pa las/ mthe'u chung gnyis bsnol ba'i bar du srin lag gnyis bzhag gung mo bshibs te bsgreng / de'i tshig gsum par mdzub mo bkan te/ mthe bong sbyar/ oṃ badz+ra ag+ni pra di pa tā ye swāhā/ rdo rje go cha bkon par gyur/ rgya de nyid sdig mdzub bskyed nas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ hūm̐ ga ki li hūm̐ phaṭa/ mgo bo dang dpung mgo gnyis/ snying kha dang mgrin pa rnams su go cha byas par gyur gyi bar gong bzhin/ che ba'i che mchog sogs bkra shis brjod do/ /shes rab snying po tshar gcig 'don te/ legs grub las/ shes rab pha rol phyin sogs kyi/ /glegs bam 'jug du bklags pa dang / /zhes so/ /de nas mo'i bskal ba'i skud pa dmar po le brgan rtsi'am gur gum gyis btsos par mdud pa bdun bor la/ oṃ ha ra ha ra/ ban+dha ni shū kra dha ra ṇi sid+dhar the swāhā/ lan stong bzlas nas srod kyi dus su sked pa la bcings te 'dzag pa bsrung bar bya'o/ /oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha tā ma tsī wa ra swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i bla gos lan gsum bsangs gtor dang bsrung bar byas la bgo zhi rdul dang dri mas ma gos par bya/

nyal ba dang khrus byed pa ma gtogs pa la thang gos mi spangs/ glegs bam bklag pa dang / mchod rten gdab pa dang / rjes su dran pa drug bsgom pa la sogs pa dge ba'i phyogs la 'bad par bya'o/ /de nas sang nyi ma shar ba dang dkyil 'khor gyi sa cha/ dkyil 'khor bkod pa yid kyi btag nas kha zas gtsang ma zos nyi ma nub nas/ khrus byas la gos gtsang ma gon te/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa phyogs byi dor legs par byas/ mchod pa sogs bshams/ spyan drangs bsnol ba med pa'i sngags sa bdag nyid bsrung ba nas/ ting nge 'dzin yang dang yang du gsal bar gyur/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed byas nas dkyil 'khor sa gzhir ba byung dang / dri bzang 'thor brtsams te sta gon la 'jug zhag gi bar ma chod na sngar gyi rnal 'byor gyi rgyun gyi sa bzung grub pa'i rjes thog nyid la/ dkyil 'khor sa gnyis ba byung / dri bzang gtor/ bh+rūṃ oṃ traṃ ban+dha swāhā/ zhes bzlas pa'i spos chus kyang gtor/ skam thig btab/ ces gsungs pa ltar na 'og thig 'debs dus ye thig kha dog lnga dang / mas thig dkar po so sor byas la byin gyis brlabs/ dkar po thig tshal gyis gshegs nas cha dbye ba yin na'ang deng sang phyag len la/ skabs 'di nyid du skya thig 'debs pas/ de yang tshangs zur bzhi gdab zer ba nas/ che chung ji tsam dbye ba yi/ /bar pa bar de gsum du dgos/ /phyi ma phyed du bgo bya des/ /nang ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /phyi la phyed gdab phyi la gdab/ /bar ma phyed du dgos pa yi/ /phyi ma mchod pa'i snam bu dang / /nang ma yan chad lha yi gnas/ /nub sgo'i sgo bzhi spyi rgyud las/ /rab tu bzang po sgo bzhir bya/ /nub phyogs sgo'am yang na ni/ /gang las ji skad bshad par dbye/ /lhag ma rnams ni dkar po yi/ /phye mas bcad par bya ba yin/ /zhes dang rgyud chen de nyid las/ chab sgo gzhan rnams bcad pa ni/ /phye ma dkar po ga gis ni/ /sgo yi dbus kyi chad ga ru/

/ri mo phra mo bri bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i yab zur rtse nas/ /cha phran gnyis dang gnyis dang bzhi/ /bskor ba pad rdor me ri sogs/ /zhes thig gdab nas/ spyi rgyud las/ sa gzhi'i steng du byug spos kyis/ /dkyil 'khor sor grangs bcu gnyis bya/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin nam yang skabs dang sbyar/ slob dpon rdor dril dri bzang gi lde gu thogs pas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha gnas gsum du dri'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi/ 'jig rten pa gsum gyi gnas su zlum po dkyil 'khor che chung gi skabs dang sbyar ba'i steng du/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ 'og mdun bskyed skabs bshad pa'i phyi nang gi mchod gtor bum pa sogs ji skad bshad pa ma tshang ba med pa bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ gdan la 'khod de/ mdun du rin po che du ma las byas pa'i sa gzhi bye ma brdal nas/ bzlas pa'i bar sa bzung skabs bzhin las khyad par spyi rgyud las/ de nas gtso bo lha rnams ni/ /ming gi yid la bsam nas su/ /zhes pa'i ming gis sngags bdun bdun brjod pas/ yid la bsam pa ni lha bsgom pa'o/ /zhes chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i yig cha khungs btsun du bka' stsal zhing / 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga sogs su mthong gsungs pas/ lha bskyed dus/ rigs snying dang / so so'i sngags bdun bdun brjod do/ /'grub na sbyin sreg sta gon yang bya/ spyi rgyud las/ de nas/ mchod pa yang byed la/ zhes dang / don zhags dkyil mchog tu dri'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pas rgyas par mchod nas zhes gsungs pas 'grub na sngar bzhin mchod pa rgyas pas mchod pa'am/ ma 'grub na a ha ra sogs bzhi'i mchod/ g.yas spos phor 'dzin/ g.yon dril bu dkrol zhing / shākya seng ge bcom ldan 'das/ /rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni snying brtser gyur nas su/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/

/sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang / /'jig rten skyongs ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu bo che/ /gang su lha'i spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bar yis/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming / /'od zer dri med ci nus kyi/ /cho ga bzhin du 'bri lags na/ /bdag dang slob ma bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs par thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ mgon po thugs rje cher ldan pa/ /sogs sngar bzhin bstod/ bstod pa 'byung ba'i sngags brjod/ dzi na dzika gats+tsha nas/ dam tshig pa rnams rim gyis bdag la thims/ lha sta gon ni/ bu ston rin po che'i dkyil chog tu dbang chog ma bshad pas/ bum sgrub dang slob ma lha gnas ma gsungs pas/ de dag spyi rgyud sogs las gsungs pa bzhin grub na legs kyang / phyag bzhes la lha btsun dbang rgyal ba'i dbang chog zin bris bzhin mdzad cing 'dug pas/ re zhig de ka sor bzhag ni/ bya rgyud la chu dbang dngos bstan gtso che zhing / de la bum bsgrub dgos pas/ bum pa'i rgyu tshad/ grangs sogs gsang ba spyi rgyud dang / legs grub 'phags pa dri ma med pa'i gzungs chog don zhags dkyil chog de'i yid ches khungs/ bya rgyud spyi rnam ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa sogs su gsal/ 'jug sgo'i bum pa gnyis phyag len bzhin bshams/ oṃ traṃ bhan+dha swāhā/ zhes de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi sngags dang bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyis sngags kyis bar du/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i rin po che'i bum pa rtsa ba dang nag po med pa/ dbus kyi dbyibs lhung bzed lta bu/

mgrin pa'i dpangs sor bzhi pa/ mgrin pa'i steng kha'i phyi rol gyi kha khyer gyi 'dab ma sor gnyis kyi tshad du mnyam pa/ kha sor bzhi pa/ zhabs kyi gdub skor dpangs sor gcig gi tshad du byas pa/ dar dkar po gtsang ma kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul pa la dkris pa/ tshon skud lngas bcings pa/ dri bzang po'i chus sum gnyis tsam gang ba'i nang du/ rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga rnams kyis yongs su gang zhing / yal ga dang / lo ma/ 'bras bur ldan pa'i shing dri zhim pos kha brgyan pa/ me tog dang / rin po che la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan pa/ 'khor lo rnams las bum pa'i dung chos kyi steng du bzhag pa la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa/ bum pa'i nang du/ shar gyi cha'i dbus su gdan ser po gru bzhi pa'i steng pad zla la/ na maḥsap+ta naṃ sogs/ dzi na dzika bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa nas/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar gyis lha drug po bskyed la/ las bum pad zla la/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags brjod/ khro bo bdud rtsi thabs sbyor sngon po/ phyag bzhi g.yas na ral gri gtun shing g.yon na dgra satwa dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /bum pa'i mtshan ma yang lha de rnams kyis skur gyur/ spyan 'dren gyi mchod yon bsgrub pa nas/ phyag gi bar sa lhas bzung ba'i skabs bzhin las/ khyad par phyag rdor spyan drangs pa'i rjes/ na mo rat+na sogs rigs pa'i rgyal po'i hūm̐ bzhi pa dang / a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li e h+ya hi/ bde bar gshegs so nas mdzad du gsol/ na mo rat+na sogs bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags kyi mthar mchod yon gyi sngags rgya btags mchod pa bsangs ba sogs kyang sa gzung gi skabs bzhin la phyag rdor rdzogs pa'i rjes su bdud rtsi thabs sbyor la tshar gnyis byed skabs rang sngags bzla bar bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags bzla/ bstod pa ni/ phyag rdor gyi rjes su/

'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing / /sogs sh+lau ka gcig de nas 'jig rten gyi lha rnams kyi bstod pa'i mthar sngags bcas brjod/ gzungs thag bzung ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams las 'od 'phros/ ngan song gi gtso byas sems can rnams kyi duḥkha dang sdig pa rnams bsal/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mchod/ de rnams las 'od zer bdud rtsi lta bur byung nas bum pa gang bar gyur/ gtso bo'i rtsa sngags dang snying po/ lha gzhan rnams kyi sngags/ rigs spyi'i snying po gsum/ las bum la bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rnams brgya rtsa re/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin/ stong gsum sogs tshig gzhan 'dra ba las/ lha rdzas me tog lha rdzas bdug spos/ zhes dang sngags/ ā ha ra sogs kyis bum pa mchod yon/ me tog spos phul/ bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang rdo rje slob ma rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba dang / dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs thams cad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /yid ched khungs btsun las/ bod kyi bla ma kha cig bum pa'i lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa chu ba'i tshul bsgom nas khrus byed par bzhed/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ lha ye shes pa gshegs pa'i gsal kha byung yang / dam tshig pa la dmigs bsal ci yang ma byung ste/ rnam 'joms kyi dkyil chog 'ga' zhig nas lha zhu ba med bshad 'dug pas/ zhu ba bya ba yang rung ba'i/ yang na bdag la bsdu bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas lugs yin la/ sgrub mchod tshar du byed kyang nyin re bzhin bskangs ba nas/ gsol gdab gyi bar bum pa sgrub/ dpe 'di kun blos bgyis pas 'di na'ang yod/

gang rigs bgyis pas mthus/ sgrub mchod rjes ma'i dus/ rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi skabs/ mdun bum gnyis kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ ras bris yin na mdun bskyed la brtan bzhugs dang / bum pa'i ye shes pa gshegs pa rnams dang lha gsal ba'i thugs kar thim/ rang gi lha yi sku gzugs zla ba'i steng gi yi ge la thim pa sogs mdzad de bum bsgrub bo/ /slob ma sta gon ni rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa'i kha bskang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzhin no/ /rnal 'byor bsdu ba/ bdag gi sku gzugs zla ba'i steng gi yi ge la thims nas/ bkra shis kyi bar bya/ shes rab snying po tshar gcig 'don pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya ste sta gon bya'o/ /bdag 'jug man 'jug blang bar 'dod na rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis bgyis pa zur na yod/ nangs par thig gi sngon du lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom dgos par gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni gsang sngags kun/ /nangs par rjes su dran byas nas/ /gos dkar dgos shing ma spongs par/ /zhes pa'i don/ nangs par snga bar langs nas gso sbyongs dang / khrus nas bzlas pa'i bar bya ba ni/ khro bo mnol ba med pa'i phyag rgyas srung ba ni/ steng nas bla bre la sogs pa'ang grub par gyur/ zhes pa'i rjes su spyan 'dren gyi mchod yon byin rlabs bar sa bzang bzhin no/ /dad pa dang ni nas/ dgyes par mdzod/ dzi na dzika shākya mu ni e h+ye hi/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa mdun du spyan drangs par gyur/ pus mo sa la btsugs te/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bcas/ bde bar gshegs so nas/ thugs dpag mdzad du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta la sogs snying po'i mthar ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ mchod yon dbul bas spyan drangs la/ las kyi bye brag las shar ram/ byang ngam/ nub tu kha bltas te/ lha mdun du bzhugs su gsol dang /

pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya las sor gsum rdo rje ltar byas pa/ rdo rje'i bdug sngags kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra ā pa ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i gdan phul nas/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung gi sen mo mnan te sor mo lhag ma rnams rdo rje ltar byas pa'am tshig gi rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang / shaṅka re sa ma ye swāhā/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas lag pa gnyis phan tshun khu tshur bcang nas mthe bong gnyis brtan par byas pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi 'di gtso bo'i dam rgya bstan phyag rgya bstan la/ dzi na dzika ces brjod do/ /de nas sor mo phan tshun sbyar ste khu tshur bcangs la gung mo gzhib pa'i phyi rol tu mdzub mo rdo rje ltar byas nas mthe bong gnyis glo la gzhar ba ni/ dam tshig chen po'i phyag rgya ste/ de bcings te bskor bas ngan du byas pa thams cad las bsrung ba chen por gyur/ bsang ba sogs mchod pa byin rlabs sngar bzhin/ bde bar gshegs so sogs/ gong bzhin mchod yon dbul/ oṃ sarba de ba sogs sku khrus gsol ba nas/ zhal zas kyi rjes su rol mo 'bul ba'i bar rgyas bsdus gang rung byas kyang chog lag len la bsdus pa byed/ legs grub las/ mgon po thugs rje nas/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na maḥsarba nas stu te swāhā/ zhes bstod pa 'byung ba'i sngags/ 'jig rten kun gyi phyogs kun na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang bzhugs dang / /dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dag /de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /tshe rab gang yang rung ba na/ /bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan dag dang / /tshe rabs 'di dag 'khor ba na/ /'dod chags dbang dang blun pa dang / /khro ba dag gis 'khrul gyur te/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /bla ma dag dang pha ma dang / /dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sbyin gnas gang yang rung ba dang / /de las gzhan pa'i sems can dag

yon tan ldan dang mi ldan la/ /sdig pa'i las rnams gang bgyis dang / /gang yang bgyi ru stsal ba dang / /gang yang cung zad yi rang ba/ /bdag med pas ni phra mo yang / /lus ngag yid kyis bgyis pa rnams/ /de dag ma lus blos bsdus nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras bcas pa/ /bdag gis da ni mngon gsum bzhin/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal te/ /skyo ba'i yid du gyur pa yis/ /thal mo sbyar te nongs pa rnams/ /yang dang yang dang so sor bshags/ /bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa rnams/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa bzhin/ /de ltar bdag gis so sor bshags/ /slan chad de ltar yongs mi bgyid/ /srog chags sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid ji srid 'tsho bar du/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /gus pas yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /de yi yon tan gus bsgrags te/ /sa la mgo bos gtugs nas ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la blo can gyi/ /de ltar gus pas skyabs su 'gro/ /de nas mchog gi sa bon gang / /thar pa bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu 'byin/ /shin tu bsgom nas mchog gyur pa/ /dngos grub phyir ni der bskyed do/ /sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i/ /sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba dang / /ngan 'gro rnams las bsgral ba dang / /nyon mongs rnams las grol ba'i phyir/ /srid pa mi bde dogs pa na/ /duḥkha sna tshogs ci mchis dang / /de ltar yongs su bskyabs pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can phongs pa thams cad kyi/ /skyabs su bdag nyid rtag tu shog /bdag ni mchog med rnams kyi mgon/ /rten med rnams ni rten du bdag /skyabs med rnams kyis skyabs 'gyur zhing / /du ཿkha bde bar byed pa dang / /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs zhi bar byed par shog /dge ba'i las rnams gang dang gang / /'di dang gzhan du bsags pa rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes zhes bya yi/ /tshogs ni rnam pa gnyis su shog /pha rol phyin pa drug sgo nas/

/bdag gi brtson 'grus gang brtsams pa/ /de yang sems can ma lus pa/ /thams cad la ni phan par shog /tshe yi mtha' klas byed par dang / /gang yang cung zad byed 'gyur ba/ /mdor na sems can thams cad kyis/ /nyon mongs thams cad zhi ba dang / /bul bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad cing / /byang chub bar du bdag brtson no/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems/ /cho ga bzhin du kun tu bskyed/ /sems can kun la snying rje dang / /byams par nye bar gnas par bya/ /sems ni legs par sbyangs ba'i phyir/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi rjes dran drug /nang gi bdag nyid zhi ba yis/ /bsam pa gcig tu bsgom par bya/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang dge ba'i sems kyis su/ /de bzhin du ni smon lam 'debs/ /chos kyi longs spyod sna tshogs la/ /mnyam par bzhag nas yi rang ngo / /sems can thams cad bde ba dang / /zhi zhing nad kyang med par shog /bdag kyang bya ba kun nus shing / /yon tan dang yang ldan par shog /nor ldan gtong phod shes rab can/ /bzod ldan dge ba dad pa dang / /sems can tshe rabs thams cad du/ /skye ba dran zhing brtse ldan shog /ces legs grub nas gsungs pa'i rgyun bshags 'dis don rnams yid la brnag pas brjod do/ /de nas bo dhi tsit+ta stong rtsa brgyad dam/ brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig blangs la mig phug ste/ ba'i rnam lngas bkrus pa'i bu mos bkal ba'i skud pa sum sgril gyis brgyus nas mdud pa bor la ā ha ra sogs mchod pa bzhis mchod nas phreng ba snyim par bcug la/ oṃ bha ga wa ti sid+dhi/ sid+dha ya/ sid+dhīr+b+ba swāhā/ de ni phreng ba'i rab gnas so/ /bzlas pa'i dus su thal mo sbyar nas bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha gsal bar gyur/ sngags kyi nor bu snyim par bcug ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ar+bhu te bi dza ya sid+dhi sid+dhār+b+ba swāhā/

zhes lan bdun bzlas pa'i byin gyis brlabs la/ snying khar phreng ba bzung la gung mo dang mthe'u chung brkyang ste mdzub mo bkug nas gung mo'i rgyab tu bzhag nas/ srin lag dang mthe bos drag pos las ma gtogs pa thams cad la bgrang ste/ sngags re re nor bu re re bgrangs pa de la rang lha gsal ba'i snying kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang mdun gyi lha gsal ba'i snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ na maḥsap+ta nāṃ sogs nas a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swāhā bar rtsa sngags dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma la sogs snying po gong bzhin brjod/ sngags kyi yi ge rnams rim pa bzhin bkod la/ mngon sum ltar bltas te/ zlog pa po'i rus rnams kyi yan lag bskum pa dang / lce yis chu btung ba ltar lus kyi dbugs rgyu ba dang / dbang po'i grong nang du bcus kyang nang gi mig phyir blta ba'i tshul gyis mig zim byas/ gdong cung zad bstod/ sgra sngags kyi phreng ba dang / sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / gzhi sangs rgyas kyi sku rnams rim pa 'dis cig char gsal bar gyur/ yid bzlas sam shub bu'i bzlas par bya'o/ /bar skabs su rlung bag yongs su bya zhing / dbugs 'byung ba na gsang sngags mi 'gyur ba'i gzhi rang gi bsgom pa'i lha la bltas nas/ yang sngar bzhin du mdun gyi sku la sogs pa gsum la dmigs shing dbugs dbyung ba'i mtha'i bar du srog rtsol bsdams la bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de ltar bzlas pa'i tshe na/ khro ba dang dga' ba la sogs pa'i rnam rtog spang / gtam gzhan mi smra/ lha gzhan mi bsgom/ yan lag 'gyur ba med par bzlas so/ /ngal na sgra la sogs pa rim pas bsdus te/ tha mal gyi ngang la ldang ngo / /gal te bzlas pa byed 'phro la gnyid bro ba'am/ g.ya' 'am/ sbrid pa'am/ glo dang lud pa'am/ 'og rlung ngam/ bshang gci byung na/ mod kho na la phreng ba bzhag ste bcag pa la sogs pa byas nas/ khrus dang nye reg byas nas bzlas pa dang po nas brtsams par bya'i sngags kyi de grangs su mi gzhag go

/phreng ba'i thog ma dang tha ma bgrang ba'i tshe na sngags kyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags bgrang ba rdzogs pa'i tshe/ lha'i ri mo'am/ sku gzugs sam/ mchod rten nam/ de'i gdan la mig gis kun tu blta bar bya'o/ /bag med pa'i lha gzhan gyi sngags bzlas nas yid kyis gsol ba btab la/ bzlas brjod slar brtsam par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i bslab bya dang ldan pas rtsa sngags dang snying po gnyis so sor ci 'grub bzlas mthar/ lag pa g.yas pa'i srin lag gi rgyab tu gung mo bzhag g.yon pa'i srin lag gi rgyab tu'ang gung mo bzhag nas sbyar te lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo'i g.yon pa'i srin lag dkri zhing g.yon pa'i mdzub mos g.yas pa'i gung mo dang srin lag dkris la/ the'u chung gnyis bshibs te bsgrang nas mthe bong gnyis mdzub mo'i tshigs dbus mar bzhag pa bum pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ bdag gis bzlas brjod kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyi don du bcom ldan 'das ma la 'bul lo/ /mgon po khyed kyis mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ tshul 'di ni bsnyen pa'i skabs sor bzhag yin pas/ des na bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshe sbyor ba'i skabs su rten drung mchod pa sogs bshams bzlas pa phul grub nas mchod bstod byas la 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin rnal 'byor bsdu'o/ /thig tshon byin rlabs kyi tshe/ oṃ traṃ bhan+dha swāhā/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir bsang gtor bya/ gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pa sngar bzhin du longs ma spyad pa'i gsar pa gtsang ma dri zhim pa/ reg na bde ba/ sbom phra ran pa/ sbom phra dang 'jur mdud med pa/ kha dog dkar dmar ser ljang nag po lnga/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar dang / slob ma nub tu 'khod pa'i slob dpon gyi phyag g.yon pa'i mdzub mo'i rtsa ba nas rtse mo'i bar du rtsig pa'i rim pa dang mthun par bkod do/

/oṃ traṃ ban+dha swāhā/ bh+rūṃ bzlas shing dang po so sor/ de nas gcig tu bsgril/ oṃ traṃ ban+dha swāhā/ brgya bzlas/ a ha ra sogs bzhis mchod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dkon mchog gsum dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la a ha ra sogs bzhis mchod/ lha rnams la dngos su phyag 'tshal zhing / oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ka ya sogs brjod/ ā ha ra sogs bzhis mchod/ shar du thig skud bsdogs te bzung / de nas lhor phyin la kha byang du bltas/ sgrub pa'i grogs mchog byang du 'dug ste/ kha lhor bltas pa'i 'og tu thig skud gtad/ de nas g.yas bskor gyi shar du song ste nub tu bltas la tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de'i tshe phyogs 'phrul spang phyir/ phyogs kyi dbye ba ni rtog pas brtags pa yin gyi/ don dam pa phyogs thams cad mnyam par nyid de/ zhes pa dang / gnam thig sa thig gnyis ka gdab/ 'debs dus/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya pū traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod pa rnams kha skang kyang legs/ de nas lhor song ste byang du bltas nas gnyis pa gdab/ de nas mer song ste byang du bltas la shar gyi rtsa thig dang / de nyid du 'dug ste nub du bltas pas lho'i rtsa thig dang / rlung du 'dug ste lhor bltas la nub kyi rtsa thig dang / de nyid 'dug nas shar du bltas la byang gi rtsa thig dang / mer 'dug ste rlung du bltas la zur thig dang / bden bral du 'dug ste dbang ldan du bltas la zur thig gnyis pa rnams gdab bo/ /dkon mchog gsum la ā ha ra sogs bzhis mchod/ khro bo'i rgyal po bsgom nas skyu ru ra'i phye ma la byas pa'i khrus chab kyis khrus byas la gos gtsang ma bgo dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi rnams la ba'i chu dang gci ba bsres la byug spos chu'i bsangs gtor byas/ phyag dar dang chag chag btab la/ me tog sil ma gtor/ sras bus bskor/ rgyal mtshan dang rta bab dang / me tog gi phreng ba brgyus pa rnams kyis brgyan la/

de nas dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad byang phyogs su bsags te/ khro bo mnol ba med pa'i sngags rgya dang / bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgyas bsrung / rtsa sngags sam snying pos bsrung ba yang spyi rgyud du gsungs/ gnas la las sngags bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags kyis bsangs gtor bya/ bgegs bsal ba'i sngags rgyas bgegs bsal/ go cha'i sngags rgyas bsrung / sems spro ba chen pos rigs gsum gyi lha la phyag byas la/ dkyil 'khor bri ba la 'jug bltas ngan pa byung na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dkyil 'khor gtso bo la mchod yon rtsa sngags kyis dbul/ me tog la sogs pas mchod pas mchod/ slob ma dang dkyil 'khor bri ba la sogs pa'i grogs rnams la bsangs gtor dang bsrung ba byas nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo 'don/ de nas phyag 'tshal gyi sngags rgya byas la dkyil 'khor bri'o/ /de la 'od zer dri med kyi gzungs las dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas la/ de'i steng du tshon lnga ri mor bris te/ dbus kyi char ni 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / dung dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dang / g.yung drung ris dang / pad+ma rnams bri'o/ /grwa bzhir yang pad+ma re re bris te/ de'i steng du spos chus bkang ba'i bum pa re re grwa bzhir bzhag go /bdug spos kyis bkang ba sna tshogs 'thul ba yang bzhag go /kha dog sna lnga'i snod du kha zas sna tshogs dang / zas dkar gsum dang 'bras chan du sbyar ba bzhag go /yang dri'i chu dang me tog dang / 'bras bu rnams 'bru'i snod bkang ba phor bu re re blug pa dang / yang kha zas sna tshogs pa sbyar ba'i gtor ma spos chu bum pa gang sbyar te dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag go /gtor ma dang / 'bras kyi drung du nye bar tshogs kyi bdag po'i gzugs bris la de'i spyi bo'i steng du mar me bzhag go /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su nad pa yod na bzhag la/

dkyil 'khor gyi nang du kha bstan nas nad pa'i mdun du mchod pa'i bshos bzhag ste 'bul du gzhug go /zhes gsungs pas 'di'i gtso cher sdig pa zhi ba'i phyir na 'bras sa lu phye ma kha bsgyur ba'am/ tshe sring ba'i phyir na rgyas pa'i las yin pas mtshal dang bab la la sogs pa'i phye ma 'byung khung nas byung ba'i tshon rnams rnam pa lnga slob dpon gyi dbus dang phyogs bzhir bkod/ bgegs bsal ba sogs sngar mchod pa byin brlabs bzhin las/ rdul tshon rnams lha rdzas kyi yo byad sogs brjod/ oṃ traṃ bhan+dhā swāhā/ brgya bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs la lha'i mtshan ma bgod pa'i gnas rnams su ba lcis bsku/ ba'i rnam lnga'i chus bkru dri chu gtor/ rdul tshon la'ang bh+rūm̐ zhes dri bzang gi chu gtor/ bu ston rin po che'i dkyil chog tu thig gdab skabs phur bus btags pa'i srad bu'i zlum bskor byas pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ dbus kyi phur bu phyung la/ bu ga rtsigs pa'i rim pa bzhin du tshon gyis bkang / re kha lnga'i sa la rdo rje khu tshur re re/ lhung bzed kyi phyag rgya'i/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya'i/ rigs byed kyi lag pas re kha lnga nang nas rim pa bzhin dkar dmar ser ljang nag lnga po g.yas bskor gyi bar ma chad pa mnyam par bris la rin po che la sogs pa'i snod kyis bkab la bzhag go /phyis sbrel ran pa dang blangs te/ mtshan ma brtags la sbrel lo/ /phyogs tshon dbus dkar/ shar dmar/ lho ser/ nub ljang / byang nag po/ gzhan rnams phar cher spyi dang mthun par bya/ sgo bzhi byed na nub sgo min pa gsum po re kha dkar po phra mos bcad la bzhag gcig las med na mi dgos so/ /zhes gsungs/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi lhan thabs las/ bskor thig mi mdzad pas thig 'debs dus kyi phur gdab ma dgos pa/ phur bu phyung ba khung du 'gengs pa ma dgos/ tshon pra rtags pa'ang 'di phyogs kyi phyag len la mi snang /

thig tshon la bskyed chog med pas gshegs gsol mi dgos/ zhes gsungs pas gang bder byas chog par mngon no/ /lha'i mtshan ma 'god pa ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i ngag 'don bzhin no/ /lha rnams kyi mtshan ma 'god pa'i tshe so so'i sngags bzla dgos te/ spyi rgyud las/ yid la de'i sngags zlos shing / /phye ma dkar pos 'bri bar bya/ /zhes so/ /mchod snam gyi grwa bzhir pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ de'i steng du spos chus bkang ba'i bum pa dkar po mgul chings kha brgyan dang bcas pa bzhag shar gyi snam bu'i steng du spos sna lnga'am gsum gang 'byor bzhag lho'i snam bu la snod kha dog lngar bsgyur ba'i nang du/ zhal zas sna tshogs dang / zho 'o ma mar ste dkar gsum dang / 'bras chan sbyar ba bzhag nub kyi snam bu la/ dri'i chus gang ba'i dung chos dang / me tog gi gang ba'i snod dang / 'bras sam/ 'bras bus bkang ba bzhag byang gi snam bu la/ kha zas sna tshogs sbyar ba'i gtor ma dang / dri'i chus gang ba'i bum pa mgul chings kha brgyan dang bcas pa spos dang me tog rnams bzhag byang gi gtor ma dang / nub kyi 'bras gnyis kyi bar sngar gyi grwa'i bum pa'i rgyab tu shing zla gam gzugs lta bu la tshogs kyi bdag po'i gzugs/ glang po che'i gdong pa can dkar po dgra satwa dang la phug 'dzin pa bris la/ de'i spyi bo'i steng du mar me bzhag par bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i mtha' skor gyi mchod pa bshams skabs/ phyogs bzhir mchod yon 'bul ba'i stegs bu'i steng du/ rdzas bdun chu gtsang dang sbyar ba'i mchod yon 'thor yab bzed zhal bcas pa re re/ dri/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ zhal zas/ 'khur ba'i bye brag shing tog sran tshod/ 'o thug rnams phyogs re tshar re/ nub phyogs su 'jig rten pa gsum la so sor tshar re'am/ thun mong du gcig rgyal mtshan spyi rgyud las/ rgyal mtshan gsar pa sna tshogs dang / brgyad ni khor rwa khor yug tu yu ba drang po ring po la/

dpyad nas nye bar bzung byas te/ /dkar po shar gyi phyogs su gzug /shar lho mtshams su le brgan gzug /lho yi phyogs su nag po gzug /lho nub mtshams su dud kha gzug /nub kyi phyogs su dmar po gzug /nub byang mtshams su khra bo gzug /byang gi phyogs su ser po gzug /byang shar mtshams su ljang ser gzug /de ltar rgyal mtshan brgyad po rnams/ /go rim bzhin du gzug par bya/ /rgyal mtshan rnams kyi rtse mo la/ /tog ni rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan/ /rgyal mtshan rnams ni ma rnyed na/ /thams cad thal kar gcig pu'am/ /yang na de bas mang yang rung / /shar gyi phyogs su gzug par bya/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis brgyan pa la sogs pa ci 'byor par bya/ dkyil 'khor bri bshams grub nas/ spyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bris nas/ /nye reg byas shing gtsang bar bya/ /lha rnams la yang phyag byas nas/ /bzang ngam mi bzang brtag par bya/ /phyi rol khar phyogs kha bltas nas/ /yid la dkyil 'khor bdag po yi/ /snying po'i gsang sngags kun bzlos shing / /mtshan ma dag ni brtag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ khrus dang nye reg byas lha rnams la phyag byas nas snying po'am/ rtsa sngags bzla zhing mtshan ma brtag par bya'o/ /de nas mchod bstod byas la 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin rnal 'byor bsdu'o/ /dkyil 'khor bris bzhengs ma grub par zhag gis bar chod na nyin re bzhin thig tshon byin rlabs kyi 'og bzhin bsgom bzlas/ mthar mchod bstod dzi na dzika gats+tsha/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ spyan drangs pa'i nas/ gshegs su gsol/ sngags kyi sprul pa'i nas/ bdag la thims/ bdag gi lha'i nas/ sher snying 'don pa'i bar gyi rnal 'byor bsdu chog bya'o/ ༈ /de ltar dkyil 'khor 'bri ba sogs grub nas/ dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod ni/ nangs par mchod pa sogs bshams/ khro bo bsnol ba med pa'i sngags rgyas bdag nyid bsrung ba nas/
