nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi cha'i dbus su gdan ser po gru bzhi pa'i steng du pad zla la zhes pa'i bar/ sa bzung bzhin/ de nas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa 'od zer phreng ba dang bcas pa/ na maḥsap+ta naṃ sogs rtsa sngags tshar gcig dzi na dzika 'khor lo de nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhal nub tu bstan pa/ de'i g.yon ngos sogs nas pad zla'i steng du'i bar sngar bzhin la rdo rje sngon po rtse mo gsum pa/ na mo rat+na nas/ hi ri mi ri ti ri ṇi swāhā/ badz+ra dhṛka rdo rje de nyid phyag na rdo rje nas/ khro bo'i lus kyi nyams la gnas pa/ de'i nub kyi nas/ zlum po'i steng du bar sngar bzhin las/ dung na mo badz+ra nas/ tsakra ya swāhā/ dung de nyid khyab 'jug nas/ thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i g.yon bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du dkyil 'khor zlum po'i steng du mdung rtse gsum/ oṃ pa shū nas/ pri ya swāhā/ mdung rtse gsum de nyid drag po dkar po nas/ glang khyu mchog la zhon pa/ de'i g.yon du g.yung drung ris kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa gnyis rim/ ngos bzhi nas shad bzhi drangs la tshig bcag ste/ g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba/ shad bzhi po dag kyang rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba/ na mo nas/ ra ti ni swāhā/ g.yung drung ris de nyid/ tshogs bdag sku mdog nas/ phyir dgyed pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ lha de gsum zhal shar du gzigs pa'o/ /shar gyi bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas byang phyogs nas/ pad zla'i steng du bar sngar bzhin la sdong bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma/ oṃ dzi nas/ de ni swāhā/ a ro lika sdong bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma de nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nas skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ spyi rgyud las/ dang po gzugs su bri bar bshad/ /gnyis pa dag ni phyag rgya bri/ /gsum pa rten dang gnas dag tu/ /bri ba'i cho ga yongs su bsgrags/

/zhes dang / phyag rgya ni/ gsum gang bkod pa/ bar ma rab du bsgrags pa yin/ /khyad par du ni de bsngags te/ /de la byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya bris na bde ba ste/ /phyag rgya gang yin de nyid lha/ /de bas mkhas pas nan tan du/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni phyag rgya bri/ /zhes gsungs pas phyag mtshan bkod pa de nyid lha bskyed chog gi sar de dag sbyar/ phyi'i snam bu'i grwa bzhir pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ de'i steng du spos chus bkang ba'i bum pa dkar po nas/ bzlas pa'i bar sa gzung bzhin bya'o/ /rang rang so so'i sngags lan gsum gsum bzlas la rang rang gi phyag rgya bcing ngo / /de la gtso bo'i phyag rgya ni gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bong g.yas pa gcig pu bstan pa spyan ras gzigs kyi'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo phan tshun bsdam pa las gung mo gnyis phyung ste brkyang pa rtse mo gcig tu byas pa/ rdo rje'i rtse mo 'dra ba byas pa phyag rdor gyi'o/ /thal mo khong stong du sbyar nas mthe bong gnyis brgyud nas cung zad bstod pa khyab 'jug gi phyag rgya'o/ /mthe chung gi rtse mo mthe bong mnan nas/ sor mo gsum brkyang pa sngar gyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya de nyid rtse mo thur du brkyang pa drag po'i mdung rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis bkan te mdzub mo dang srin lag rnams bsnol te dkris pa la mthe bo gnyis lag pa'i nang du bkug nas sor mo lhag ma rnams ni thams cad kyang 'dra ba so sor bkug nas/ lag pa'i mthil du gdu bu ltar bkug pa ni g.yung drung ris kyi'o/ /de nas rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgya 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ dzi na dzika a ro lika badz+ra dhṛka rnams so so nas gsum bzla/ ā ha ra sogs spos kyi sngags rgya/ bstod pa sngags bcas/ 'jig rten dag gi nas/ brtse ldan shog bar bzlas/ sangs rgyas chos dang nas/ sems bskyed do bar/

sher phyin sogs glegs bam bklag ma 'grub na sher snying tshar gcig dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod do/ /'chi bslu/ srog shing 'dzugs pa/ tshogs bsog sogs byed na 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin de dag la 'jug slob ma dbang bskur ba'am mi bskur yang bdag 'jug len par spro na/ de'i tshul ni spyi rgyud na mi gsal yang / cho ga zhib mor gsungs pas/ bla ma'i bya ba rnams gtso bos mdzad/ las kyi slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams las thams cad kyi khro bos byas par bsgom/ slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis byas par bsgom la/ las bum gyi chu dang / ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ gi bar gyi khrus bya/ sta gon zur na yod/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi nas/ thams cad kyi yongs su gang ba 'di nyid bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa tha mi dad pa la/ dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug cing dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /i daṃ gu ru maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ zhes maṇ+ḍal dbul la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsang sngags spyod pa bsgrub pa la yang dag par zhugs pa dang / 'jig rten pa thams cad las shin tu 'das pa rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gsang chen du yang dag par zhugs pa dang / chos kyi rgyal srid dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du lhag par 'gyur bar slob dpon spro bar mdzod cig zhes 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas 'byung ba lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab la/ de la bar chad bsrung ba/ sngar bsrung 'khor du bshad pa'am/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa sā+e na pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sa ra nas/ brtan par byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas pa dang / oṃ badz+ra ag+ni nas mgrin pa rnams su go cha byas par gyur/ zhes go cha'i sngags kyis go bkon zhing las sngags dang / bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags kyis bsrung / las bum gyis chus/ oṃ traṃ bhan+dha swāhā dang bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags bzla zhing bsangs/

dzi na dzika zhes pas mngon par bsngags nas/ oṃ traṃ bhan+dha swāhā/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor btab pa'i gdong g.yogs sbyin/ thal mo bkan pa las mdzub mo gnyis cung zad bkug ste mgo la bzhag la/ oṃ ta thā ga ta ud+bha ba ye swāhā/ zhes de bzhin gshegs rigs spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgya bcings la de me tog phreng ba bzung / srog chags/ rdul nas/ bdag brtson no bar gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed lan gsum bya/ las kyi rdo rjes sna 'khrid de bskor ba lan gsum bya/ de nas thal mo sbyor la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra pra ṇa me na sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pā da bhan+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas sgo bzhi nas rim pa bzhin phyag 'tshal/ yang nub sgo nas phyag gsum btsal la/ de nas 'jug sgo'i bum pa'i chus gtso bo'i snying po'i sngags la/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca btags pa'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing 'thung ba ni phyi'i 'jug pa'o/ /rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad par gyur/ zhes gtso bor bskyed la gtso bo'i phyag rgya ni/ lag pa gnyis phan tshun khu tshur bcangs nas/ mthe bong gnyis brtan par byas pa spyi bor bzhag la/ na maḥsap+ta naṃ sogs lan gsum bzlas la bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ dril bu bsil zhing / 'di ltar bdag gi slob ma 'di/ /dkyil 'khor du ni legs btsud nas/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag /'di yi bsod nams ci 'dra las/ /de bzhin du ni 'bab par 'gyur/ /'dis ni dngos grub gang 'grub dang / /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu ni ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra ur+gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ye hūm̐/ nub sgo dbye/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs par gyur/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung / rang gi snying kar thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/

'di ni cho ga gzhan nas bshad pa'i ye shes dbab pa de'i dang po yin pas gal che'o/ /yid ches khung btsun du gsungs/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar sngar byin pa'i me tog gi phreng ba bzung la/ me tog rang gi lha la dbul snyam par byas te/ dkyil 'khor du dor/ gdong g.yog dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'o/ /me tog gang la bab pa de rigs kyi lha yin no/ /de nas gdong g.yog bkrol te/ dkyil 'khor ltar bcug par bsam la/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /sngags dang rigs pas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum dngos grub kyang / /thams cad khyod la mngon du 'gyur/ /dngos grub phyir ni dam tshig bsrung / /gsang sngags dag la'ang brtson par gyis/ /zhes gsang bar bsam/ rang gi me tog gi snyim pa bkang nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bsngos nas phyag btsal te lan gsum gtor ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi me tog phreng ba de blangs te/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha de'i snying po'am/ sngags kyi phreng ba bsgom te de nyid bzlas la gnang bar bsam/ rang gi sngags kyi phreng ba mos pas blangs te sngags de lan gsum du bzla'o/ /deng sang phyag len la gtso bo'i dbu la bab par mos la dbul ba'i stangs ka tsam byas te gtso bo'i snying po bzla'o/ /dkyil 'khor la phyag sngags rgya dang mchod pa ā ha ra sogs bzhis mchod/ bskor ba bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid can du zhugs pa ste/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i cho ga'o/ /stan gsar ba la kha nub tu phyogs par bzhag par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra aghi nas mgrin pa rnams su go cha byas par gyur/ zhes pa'i sngags rgyas go bkon/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas bzhugs par gyur/ zhes gtso bor bskyed pa gsal btab nas gtso bo'i rtsa ba'i phyag rgya sngar bshad pa gnas lngar btugs te/

dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sngags rnams 'don zhing las kyi khro bos spyi bor gdugs dkar po la me tog dkar po'i phreng bas brgyan cing ras phran dkar po'i ba dan dpyangs pa bzung / legs par sbyar ba'i bdug pa khro bo'i sngags kyis bdug g.yas g.yon gyi rnga g.yab bsil g.yab 'dzin pa dang / spos phor thogs pas spos dbul zhing / slob mas kyang yon phul la/ bla mas de la sngags kyis skyon bsal zhes pa la/ yid ches khungs btsun du sngags kyi skyon bsal/ bkra shis bya/ zhes pa'i skabs su sbyang ba gcig thob pa 'dra ste/ gsal po ma byung bas ma bkod do/ /zhes gsungs/ shis pa'i cho ga bya ba ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /nas/ bkra shis gsum pa yin zhes pa'i bar gyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blangs/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher 'don/ dung dang rnga bo che la sogs pa'i rol mo bya'o/ /las kyi khro bo des/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha kun la gsol ba btab nas/ ༈ bum pa rang rang gi sngags kyi bzlas brjod brgyar byas pa rnams legs par blangs nas dkyil 'khor dal bus lan gsum du bskor zhing rang gi spyi bor bzhag nas lha so so'i sngags kyi rjes su badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca btags pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / khrus byas/ 'thung ba thams cad rdzogs pa dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu dang gtso bo'i sngags 'don cing / dbang bskur bas mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi dri ma thams cad dag lha so so'i ye shes thob pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag par gyur par bsam ste chus dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs rigs spyi'i phyag rgya sngar bshad pa spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ur+bha ba ye a bhi ṣiñca zhes/ rin po che'i cod paṇa dang dar dpyangs bcings pa cod paṇa gyi dbang dang / de nas chus bang pa'i gos brjes par bsam nas oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sogs gos kyi sngags kyis gos gsar pa gon par bsam/

nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sogs gos kyi sngags brjod de/ ze'u kha bcings par gyur/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru sogs bzlas pa'i gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pa sum sgril mdud pa gsum bor ba'i dbus su bo dhi tse'i phreng rdog gcig bcug pa'i gdub bu mkhrig ma g.yon pa la gdag par gyur/ zhes gdub bu gdags/ las kyi khro bo des/ rang nyid kyi steng du gdugs gzug thal mo sbyar nas dkyil 'khor la bskor bar byed du bcug ste/ nub sgo nas gdugs dang bcas pa'i spyi bos btud pa'i phyag 'tshal du bcug par bsams la/ las kyi khro bo des/ sngags dang rgyud ni 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /zhes pas lha la phul ste/ de nas gdugs gzhan du bzhag la/ rang gi lag pas blangs te/ 'di skad ces bsgo bar bsam/ da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /gsang sngags rgyud kyang 'dzin pa dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kyang ni kun gyi bskur/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse'i phyir/ /khyod kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /nan tan bskyed de bri bar byos/ /sgrub pa po yang rgyud la sbyor/ /zhes bsgo bar bsam la/ de nas sbyin sreg bya bar bshad kyang deng sang skabs 'dir mi 'grub pa mang bas ma bris/ de nas yon dbul bar bsam/ las sngags gnyis bzla zhing las bum gyi chus spyi bor nas gtor nas/ 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ zhes dang / gzungs dang snying po rnams klog me tog gi snyim pa bkang nas lha la dbul/ de nas yon ci bdog pa dbul bar bsam/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo bklags nas dam tshig bsgo bar bya ste/ de ring phyin chad khyed rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang ni/

/rig sngags gsang sngags tshogs rnams la/ /dad pas rab tu brten par byas/ /rtag par phyag rgya chen po la/ /khyad par du ni mos par bya/ /dam tshig can dang mdza' bo dang / bla ma la yang gus par bya/ /lha rnams kun la sdang mi bya/ /dus mtshams dag tu mchod par bya/ /ston pa gzhan gyi gzhung mi mchod/ /rtag tu glo bur mgron mchod bya/ /srog chags rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /rab tu brten par nye bar bzhag /theg pa la ni dga' rnams kyis/ /bsod nams dag la nan tan bskyed/ /bzlas brjod byed la 'bad pa yis/ /gsang sngags spyod la brtson par bya/ /gsang sngags rgyud las bstan pa yi/ /dam tshig rnams kyang bsrung bar bya/ /dam tshig med pa rnams la ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgya mi sbyin no/ /gsang sngags rgyud ni legs gsungs zhing / /de yang bdag gis rtogs par bya/ /zhes brjod do/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes de rnams bsrung bar khas blangs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang las kyi khro bo la/ phyag phyag gi sngags rgya gsum gsum btsal nas ci 'byor nyer mchod pa'i yon phul nas/ bdag la rig sngags stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab cing las kyi khro bos kyang dkyil 'khor pa rnams la gsol ba btab par bsam/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sngags kyi phreng ba gnas pa las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung nas bdag gis snying ka'i zla ba la gnas par gyur/ na maḥsap+ta naṃ sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā sogs/ oṃ dzi dzika sogs/ na mo rat+na tra ya sogs/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi sogs/ oṃ pa shū sogs/ na mo badz+ra pa ṇi sogs/ sngags rnams tshar gsum re bzlas la/ las kyi khro bos me tog rang gi mgor bzhag par bsam la/ bcom ldan 'di la bsnyen pa dang / /'di la rab tu 'go bar mdzod/ /gsum/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/

/gsum/ yang sngar bzhin sngags rnams gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bzlas la nyer mchod phul/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang / deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum bya ba ni bdag 'jug go /rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams gsar pa bshams/ bgegs bsal nas/ gzi byin bskyed pa sogs sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ mchod yon grub nas/ rol mo'i bar/ gtso bo sum 'gyur sogs rgyas pa dang / nang gtor/ mgon po thugs rje sogs bstod pa nas/ skye ba dran zhing brtse ldan shog /ces pa'i bar mdun bskyed mchod bstod rgyas pa bzhin/ phyag len la mi mdzad/ phyi rol/ nye reg sgrub khang gi sgor bsangs ba sogs sngar bzhin byas nas stan la 'khod de/ bla ma dang 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir gyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag dpal ldan bla ma gong ma zhi bar gshegs pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs zag med kyi dgongs pa khyad par can rnams gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ da ltar zhal bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis gtso bor mdzad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad sku khams bzang zhing / sku tshe bstan par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang dam tshig gi nyams chag thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mtho ris dang / thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyis bar du gcod pa dang /

mi dge ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gnas skabs su yang las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis 'byung po'i gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi bye brag gdon chen po bco brgyad dang / bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu dang / log 'dren dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / byad stims dang / pha rol rig sngags las gyur pa'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ me dang / chu dang / sa g.yo ba la sogs pa 'byung ba las gyur pa'i gnod pa dang / legs nyes dang / dgra'i gnod pa la sogs pa 'jigs pa chen po bcu drug dang / mu ge dang / mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang / dbul zhing phongs pa dang / dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i duḥkha dang / de dag gi rgyud bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad pas du yang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sngon gyi las las gyur kyang rung / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur kyang rung ste/ phyi nang gi nye bar 'tshe ba dang / lus sems la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs dang / nad la sogs pa lus kyi duḥkha dang / sems yid mi bde ba dang / skal ba ngan pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa dang / lus dang / srog dang / longs spyod dang / skal ba dang / dge ba sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs su yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi nas/ 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thugs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub mtha' dag 'grub pa dang / mthar thug sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa zhi ba'i phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma dang 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/

bdag cag rnams so so'i skye bor gyur pas sems nyon mongs pa can du gyur nas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa nyon mongs pa dang 'dres shing bag med par gyur pas/ rnal 'byor la dbang ma thob pas sems bying ba dang / rgod pa'i dbang du gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / snyigs ma lnga'i dus kyi dbang gis nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang / mchod rdzas med cing ngan pa dang / brjed nges pa dang / shes bzhin ma yin pa dbang du gyur nas/ cho ga lhag pa dang / chad pa dang / ser sna'i dbang gis mchod pa ngan zhing chung ba dang / gti mug gi dbang gis rgyud sde nas 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa dang / 'khrul zhing nongs pa thams cad bzod par bzhes nas bdag cag gi sa lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya bdun/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs/ lhag pa dang ni sogs/ ser sna'i dbang gis sogs/ bag med spyod pa sogs/ gang yang bdag blo sogs/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / yang dag par ldan pa'i dge ba dang / yid bde ba nyid kyis mi mchog sangs rgyas su tshe 'di nyid la gyur cig bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol/ /yig brgya 'don zhing dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum mam bdun byas/ nub sgo'i thad nas/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /nas/ de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gshegs gsol gyi phyag rgya dang /

dzi na dzika gats+tsha nas/ sngar gyi sprul pa'i dam tshig pa rnams rim gyis bdag la thim/ bdag gi lha'i sku gzugs zla ba'i steng gi yi ge la thim nas/ zla ba rnam smin gyi lus la thim par gyur/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi byang / nub/ lho/ shar rnams tshangs thig gi lam nas/ me ri nas/ rtsig pa la reg pa'i bar rdo rjes ri mo byas/ lha mtshan mas rim gyis maṇ+ḍal steng du bsdus/ gtso bos mtshan ma rang gi spyi bor bzhag rdul tshon rnams phyags la bum par blugs mchod rdzas dman pa dang lhan cig gi klu chog gis klu rnams la gtad de rgya mtshor spyan drangs par bsam/ mtshor 'bab pa'i chu la dor ste/ spyi rgyud las/ dman pa rnams ni phyags nas su/ /mtsho chen bar du dor bar bya/ /bza' ba dang ni bca' ba rnams/ /ci yang mos pa rnams la sbyin/ /khyi dang bya rog la sogs la/ /cung zad tsam yang mi sbyin no/ /yo byad rdzas rnams thams cad ni/ /slob dpon dag gis bsdus nas su/ /bdag rang nyid kyis spyad par byed/ /slob ma rnams la bgor mi rung / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni yo byad kun/ /slob dpon bdag nyid dbang bar bshad/ /de nas slob mas spyad na ni/ /dam tshig las ni nyams par 'gyur/ /gang zhig spyod par mi 'dod na/ /de'i cho ga rim 'di'o/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi yo byad du/ /de dag cho ga bzhin du dbul/ /gdugs dang rnga g.yab dril bu sogs/ /sangs rgyas nyid la dbul bar bya/ /gdan dang bdug spos dri la sogs/ /dam pa'i chos la dbul bar bya/ /gos dang yo byad snod la sogs/ /dge 'dun rnams la dbul bar bya/ /de dag la ni slob ma yis/ /cung zad tsam yang mi bskur ro/ /dge 'dun med na dge slong sbyin/ /yang na dge slong ma la sbyin/ /gal te bdag nyid mi 'dod na/ /dge bsnyen dag la sbyin par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ rdul tshon gyi snod bum pa chus bkang bas dkyil 'khor gyi khang par byin brlabs kyi rgyun brtan pa'i phyir bsangs gtor bya/

oṃ hu lu nas/ ma taṅgi swāhā/ ra ba dang nas/ dgrol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ag+ni nas/ dī pa ta ye swāhā/ rdo rje'i go cha gyon par gyur/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ hūm̐ kha ki li hūm̐ phaṭa/ mgo bo dang nas/ mgrin pa rnams su go cha byas par gyur/ zhes pa'i sngags rgya rnams sngar bzhin dkyil 'khor bris pa'i sa gzhi la me tog gi char 'bebs shing bkra shis kyi cho ga rgyas par byas/ sher snying tshar gcig 'don no/ /sgrub mchod sbrel nas byed na/ sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir la bsgrol/ /zhes pa'i rjes su mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyis rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa sa tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas me tog 'thor zhing brtan bzhugs bya/ bdag gi lha'i sku'i gzugs nas/ rnam smin gyi lus la thim par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ag+ni nas/ mgrin pa rnams su go cha byas par gyur/ che ba'i che mchog sogs bkra shis bya/ sang nang par mchod pa sogs bshams/ khro bo mnol ba med pa'i sngags rgyas bsrung ba nas/ che ba'i che mchog gi bar brjod ma thag pa bzhin bya'o/ /slob ma la dbang bskur tshul ni rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa'i kha skang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzhin no/ /yang 'chi bslu byed na/ bdag mdun gyi sgrub mchod gong bzhin la/ gang gi don du bya ba de la dmigs nas ring bsrel can gyi mchod rten la bskor ba lan bdun cu rtsa bdun bya/ rtsa sngags lan bdun cu rtsa bdun bzlas brjod byas la/ sngags 'don pa dang yi ge 'bri mkhan khrus byas/ gos gtsang ma gon/ kha zas gtsang ma zos la/ me tog dang bdug pas mchod/ rin po che la sogs pa'i yon gyis mgu bar bya/ rtsa sngags bdun cu rtsa bdun bris te/

i mthing pa dang a bha ya'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i tsha tsha'i cho ga chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas bkral ba ni/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams bsags/ brtags te rung ba'i phyogs nas sa len tshul ni/ tshon skud la oṃ badz+ra sū tra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes bzlas pas/ brgya tshad ci ran gcig tshon skud kyis bskor ste/ mtha' ma phur pa gdab pa'i cho ga byas la/ yungs dkar dang dri bzang bsres pa la sngags bzlas pa phyogs bzhir gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra kha na kha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas pas rin po cher bsam la bsko/ bskos tshar ba dang / hūm̐ bzhi pas phur bu brton te sangs rgyas spyan gyi sngags bzlas pa'i 'o ma bu gar blug la sa rnams snod gtsang ma bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ga ra a ko tra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas la brdung / oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa'i spos chu/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i 'od zer gyis spos chu la khyab par 'khyil nas/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam la sbrus te/ oṃ badz+ra pra mar+dha na ya swāhā/ zhes bzlas te brdzis la/ 'jim seng gi bsdu na 'di man gyi chog par gsungs steng du lag pa g.yon pa gan rkyal du byas pa'i mthe'u chung gi sen mo mthe bos mnan te sor mo gsum nas re tsam bar phye ste bzhag pa'i steng du/ g.yas pa de ltar byas nas kha sbub pa bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgyas reg nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bai ro tsā na pra bha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+sam bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya th+ya/ oṃ pūk+ṣ+me pūk+ṣ+me/ sa me sa ma ye/ shāb+te dāb+te a pa mā re s+ye/ a na lam+bhi ta ra lam+be ya sho ba ti ma hā te dzo ni rā ku li nirbā ṇi/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swāhā/ zhes lan nyer gcig brjod pas 'jim gang las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa rin po che lnga'i gang bur gyur par bsam/ oṃ ba su dhe swāhā/ zhes pa'i 'jim pa blangs la/

oṃ badz+red+bha ba ya swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas ye shes lnga'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu bkang ste/ 'gro ba mang po'i don byas/ slar 'dus te 'bi 'bi la thims pas ye shes lnga rgyas te shel gong dag pa ltar bsam/ de nas gur gum bzang po'i gro ga'am/ shog bu la na maḥsap+ta naṃ sogs rtsa sngags bris la gur gum byugs kyang rung / rab gnas 'di gong gi rtsa sngags bdun cu rtsa bdun pa dang srid pa'i zhes sogs yin bsdus pa byas la grabs su bcug pa las/ re re 'bi 'bi'i nang du gzhug cing / oṃ badz+ra dharma dhā tu gar+bhe dz+wa la swāhā/ zhes brjod pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes nang du zhugs par bsam/ de nas byang chub sems kyis bsgos par bsam zhing / oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze swāhās rdul bsku/ thabs shes 'grel pas chos dbyings su bzhugs par bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra dhā ru gar+bhe swāhā/ zhes brjod la rgyar gzhug ye shes chen po'i ngo bo ro gcig tu gyur par bsam zhing sngar gyi brdung ba'i sngags dang rten 'brel snying po brjod la brdung / rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos thams cad rdzogs par bsam zhing / oṃ dharma ra te swāhā/ zhes pas dbyung / phyung ma thag thabs shes zung 'brel las chos sku grub par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dharma kā ya ma hā su kha ra ta sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de las gzugs sku rnam gnyis byung bas 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad par bsam ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sam+bho ga kā ya sa ma ya satwaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nirmā ṇa kā ya sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod/ stong pa'i ngang du brtan par bzhugs par bsam zhing / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes brjod la mdun du me tog gi gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ sbum bsku ba'i sngags dang dmigs pas sku dkar gsol/ dkyil 'khor mtha' bskor du bzhugs su gsol la 'khor ba ji srid bar sems can gyi don la bzhugs su gsol bar bsam zhing /

oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā kha ta a ṇi sha ta daṃ ste dz+wa la dz+wa la dharma dhā tu gar+bhe swāhā/ zhes pas rab gnas bya/ bsdu na des chog 'chi bslu grangs gsog byed na cho ga tshar re la sats+tsha gzungs can cho ga de bzhin byas pa bdun cu rtsa bdun re grub pa bya zhing / sats+tsha snga ma rnams rang bzhin dag pa'i ngang nas sems can gyi don la gshegs par bsam zhing / oṃ swa bhā wa bi shūd+dha ā ha ra ā ha ra a gats+tsha a gats+tsha dharma dhā tu gar+bhe swāhā/ zhes pas gzhan du gdan drangs/ zhes pa bzod par gsol bar bsam zhing / oṃ ā kā sha dhā tu gar+bhe swāhā/ zhes brjod do/ /rgyas par na mkhan po bo dhi sa twas mdzad pa'i dri med kyi gzungs kyi cho ga 'don pa kha spos la bya'o/ /de nas bsgrub bya gang yin de khrus byas gos gtsang ma gyon la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sgo'i nub phyogs su bzhag nas/ de'i mdun du mchod pa tshang ba dang / khyad par lha bshos 'byor tshad kyis bzang du byas te/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs byas la/ mchod pa'i tshigs bcad dang sngags rgyas dbul du gzhug grwa bzhi'i bum pa la rtsa ba'i sngags bdun cu rtsa bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs nas sngags rgyas 'bul ba'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin bdun dang / snying po'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas yid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams las 'od zer 'phros ngan song gi gtsor byas sems can rnams kyi duḥkha dang sdig pa rnams bsal/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mchod/ de thams cad las 'od zer bdud rtsi lta bu byung nas bum pa gang bar gyur/ bzlas pa byas la de'i bsgrub bya de la rtsa sngags bdun cu rtsa 'og dbang chog nyid kho nas 'byung ba bzhin bdun bzlas la khrus sogs bya ste/ phyogs bzhi nas mchod ā ha ra sogs bzhis mchod nas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing smon lam 'debs su stsal te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos dang /

byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa dkon mchog bla na med pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu na sku gdung ring bsrel dang bcas pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / ku be ra dang / tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi gzungs dang de dag la brten pa'i gang zag rnams bsrung zhing skyong ba lhag par phyag mtshan du bzhed pa rnams dang / gzhan yang sngon gdan 'dzom pa chen pos bkas gtad cing so so nas kyang lha'i ngag btags pas zhal gyis bzhes te dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnams bzhi bsrung zhing skyong ba thugs dam mnga' ba 'phags pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang dri chab/ bdug spos dang me tog zhal zas dang mar me/ rol mo dang sil snyan/ gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa dngos su ci 'byor pa 'di dag dang phyogs bcu na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i lha rdzas dang / mi'i bde ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa 'byor pa thams cad dang / gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa chos kyi dbyings su rtogs pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste 'bul zhing mchod do/ /de ltar lan gsum bzlas/ 'phags pa thams cad dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba thog ma ma mchis pa nas 'khor ba nas 'khor ba'i tshe lus dang ngag dang yid kyis/

sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang pha ma dang sems can gzhan dag la sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba ci mchis pa de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdams shing bsdus te sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar bla na med pa'i so sor bshags pas 'chags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /slan chad kyang 'di lta bu mi bgyid do/ /de ltar lan gsum du'o/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bsod nams kyi rjes su yi rang ba bla na med pa thugs su chud pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang rgyal ba dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /de ltar lan gsum du'o/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi bcad par bgyi ba'i slad du dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba skyes bu chen po khyu mchog sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bla na med pa'i chos kyi sku mnga' ba la skabs su mchi'o/ /chos 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ bla na med pa de bzhin gshegs pa mnga' ba zhi ba chos kyi sku so so rang gis rig pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun dul ba tshogs kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ phyogs bzhi 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de ltar lan gsum du bya'o/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la gnas kyi bar du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dus ji lta ba dang stobs ci mchis pa bzhin du bdag 'bul zhing mchis na/

mgon po thugs rje chen po dang bden pa dag bdag bzhes su gsol/ de ltar lan gsum du bya'o/ /phyogs bcu'i ston pa bla na med pa/ sangs rgyas la 'gro ba mang po la phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med par bskor ba bskul lo/ /de ltar lan gsum du bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi sgron ma mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa rnams la 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad cing 'jig rten la gtan du bzhugs par gsol bar 'tshal lo/ /de ltar lan gsum du bya'o/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang / sems can thams cad sgrol ba dang / sems can thams cad dbugs 'byung ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / sems can thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dgod pa'i slad du ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang / dus 'di nas bzung nas snying po byang chub la gnas kyi bar du sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang / sems can thams cad sgrol ba dang / sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / sems can thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dgod pa'i slad du bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang / gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi rang gi sems bzod ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la gnas kyi bar du byang chub tu sems bskyed do/

/ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis bdud dpung dang bcas pa pham par mdzad/ de nyid mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang bdud dpung dang bcas pa mtha' dag pham par bgyis te/ bdag nyid mngon par rdzogs par mtshang rgya bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas tshogs yongs su bsdus pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas tshogs yongs su bsdu bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /de ltar lan gsum du'o/ /bdag gis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang / gzhan yang bdag gis bsod nams cung zad cig bgyis pa dang / bgyid pa dang / bgyid par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad pha ma la sogs pa sems can thams cad dang / bdag gi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /bdag gis bsod nams 'dis pha ma la sogs pa'i sems can ma bsgral ba rnams ni bsgral lo/ /ma grol ba rnams ni grol lo/ /dbugs ma phyin pa rnams ni dbugs dbyung ngo / /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas pa rnams ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bgyi'o/

/skyabs ma mchis pa dang / gnas ma mchis pa dang / dpung gnyen ma mchis pa'i 'jig rten la skyabs dang gnas dang dpung gnyen du gyur cig bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rlabs chen 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog /des na bdag sbyin pa stsol ba dang / tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / bzod pa bsgom pa dang / brtson 'grus brtsom pa dang / bsam gtan la mnyam par 'jog pa dang / shes rab rnam par spyod pa dang / thabs mkhas pa la slob pa ci yang rung ste/ de dag thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don du phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las brtsams te/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa/ sa chen po la gnas pa rnams kyi rjes su mthun par 'jug go /'phags pa dag bdag byang chub sems dpa' lags kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' legs par bzung du gsol/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /rtsi dang nags kyi shing lta bur/ /rtag tu srog chags thams cad kyis/ /'dod dgur rtag tu spyod par shog /mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang / /thos pa dang ni dran pas kyang / /bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi/ /nad rnams gso ba bgyi gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro dag ni rtag tu spang bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag su bzhugs pa/ /de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'i bar 'don pa kha spos la bya/ de tsam ma grub na/ 'di nyid kyis dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ba nas/ smon lam gdab pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya/ mgon po thugs rje che sogs bstod pa 'byung ba'i sngags kyi bar dang / 'jig rten kun gyi phyogs kun na nas/ skye ba dran zhing brtse ldan shog gi bar/

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / 'phags pa chos skyong ba'i tshogs thams cad bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi gzungs nas 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/ de'i rtsa ba'i sngags bdun cu rtsa bdun bris nas nang du bcug pa'i mchod rten bdun cu rtsa bdun btab ste/ mchod cing mnga' gsol ba yang bgyis/ dkyil 'khor bris te 'phags pa'i tshogs dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pa rnams gdan drangs nas mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba rnams kyis mchod cing gsol ba btab pa dang / gzungs sngags bzlas shing 'byung po rnams gtor mas tshim par byas pa'i mthus/ che ge la sogs pa las dang nyon mongs pas mnar zhing nad dang sdug bsngal gyis gtsos/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bas nyen te skyabs su song ba rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs nas sngon gyi smon lam bzang po las gleng ste che ge mo la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi duḥkha dang gnod pa thams cad byang zhing zhi ba dang / phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba byin gyis brlabs shing ji ltar 'tshal ba bzhin du 'grub pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal bar ci gnang / sngon bram ze ser skya'i zla ba la thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas/ dpal gyi mgur nas 'di skad du/ gang la la 'di'i cho ga byed par 'dod na/ tshes brgyad dang / bcu gsum dang / bcu bzhi dang / bco lnga rnams gang yang rung ba la/ mchod rten ring bsrel can la lan bdun cu rtsa bdun bskor la/ gsang sngags 'di lan bdun cu rtsa bdun bzlas brjod byas te/ khrus byas la/ dkyil 'khor byas nas gsang sngags kyi yi ge bdun cu rtsa bdun bris te/

de'i tshe gsang sngags gdon pa dang / yi ge 'bri ba yang khrus byas la/ gos gtsang ma gyon ste/ lus spos kyis byugs nas kha zas gtsang ma zos la/ me tog dang bdug pas mchod de/ de la rin po che sna bdun yang yon du phul lam/ yang na bdag gi nyams kyi ci 'byor pa phul yang rung ste/ sems mgu bar bya'o/ /chos btsun par bya ba'i phyir bsti stangs dang ri mo cher bya'o/ /gsang sngags kyi yi ge la yang dkon zhing rin po cher 'du shes bzhag ste/ mchod rten che chung ji tsam nus pa bdun cu rtsa bdun gdab par bya zhing / de re re'i nang du gsang sngags bcug ste sems rtse gcig tu mchod pa chen po byas na tshe zad pa la tshe slar nur ste/ tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa/ tshe rabs grangs med pa'i sdig pa thams cad byang nas nam du yang sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags kyi skye gnas thams cad du skye ba mi 'gyur ro/ /gang du skyes pa'i gnas thams cad du yang sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par 'gyur/ yid la bsam pa thams cad kyang de bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa bdun snyed la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig nad po ches btab ste 'chi ba'i dus byed pa la thugs na dkyil 'khor gru bzhi par byas la de'i steng du tshon lngas ri mor bris te/ dbus kyi char ni 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / dung dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dang / g.yung drung ris dang / pad+ma rnams bri'o/ /grwa bzhir yang pad+ma re re bris te de'i steng du spos chus bkang ba'i bum pa re re grwa bzhir bzhag go /bdug spos kyi snod bkang ba spos sna tshogs 'thul ba yang bzhag go /kha dog sna lnga'i snod du kha zas sna tshogs dang zas dkar gsum dang / 'bras chan du sbyar ba bzhag yang dri'i chu dang me tog dang /

'bras sam 'bras bu'i snod bkang ba phor bu re re blug pa dang / yang kha zas sna tshogs sbyar ba'i gtor ma spos chu bum pa gang dang sbyar te dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag go /gtor ma de dang 'bras kyi drung du nye bar tshogs kyi bdag po'i gzugs bris la de'i spyi bo'i steng du mar me bzhag go /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su nad pa bzhag la dkyil 'khor gyi nang du kha bstan pa'i nad pa'i mdun du yang mchod pa'i bshos bzhag ste 'bul du gzhug go /de nas sngags mkhan gtsang sbra cher byas te nad pa de la gsang sngags bdun cu rtsa bdun gyis btab ste cho ga 'di ltar byas na nad pa tshe zad de 'chi ba'i dus byed du nye ba zhag bdun nas dran pa nyams zhing 'khrul ba gyur pa yang / tshe slar zhugs zhing tshe ring por 'gyur ro/ /rmi lam gyi duḥkha yang myong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig gis gtsang sbra cher byas te nyin gcig bzhin rtag par gsang sngags lan re re ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du bton na/ de 'chi ba'i dus byas nas longs spyod dang bde ba mi zad pa'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag par dus thams cad du bzlas brjod byas na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i zhing du skye ba 'gyur zhing / tshe rabs rjes su dran par yang 'gyur ro/ /dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba sgrib pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro/ /yang gang la la zhig gis mi shi ba'i ched du phan pa 'dod pas sems thag pa nas gsang sngags lan bdun cu rtsa bdun bzlas brjod byas na shi ba de ngan song gi gnas su ltung na yang de'i mod la las kyi sgrib pa rnams zad nas mtho ris kyi lha'i gnas su skye zhing bde ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig gis gsang sngags yi ger bris pa gzhan gyi ming nas smos te mchod rten gyi nang du bcug la nan tan du mchod pa byas na/ shi ba gang yin pa de ngan song gi gnas nas thar te mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ro/

/yang na dga' ldan gyi lha'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis rlabs kyi ngan song du ltung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis mchod rten de la bskor ba byas sam/ phyag byas sam/ mchod pa phul yang rung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyi bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam las phyir mi ldog par yang 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa rnams kyang ma lus pa byang bar 'gyur ro/ /tha na bya dang ri dwags la sogs te gang dag la mchod rten de'i grib ma phog pa de dag kyang nam du yang dud 'gro la sogs pa ngan song gi gnas su skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang la la mtshams med pa lnga'i sdig pa chen po dang ldan pa yang mchod rten de la reg gam/ de'i grib mas phog kyang rung ste de'i sdig pa thams cad byang zhing dag par 'gyur ro/ /mchod rten de'i gnas na 'byung po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za la sogs pa lus brdug cing gnod pa dang / gcan gzan khro bo dang / thog 'bab pa dang / sdig sbrul kha gdug pa dang / sbyar dug la sogs pa thams cad kyis kyang mi tshugs shing med par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / mtshon dang / me dang / chu dang / ser ba dang / mu ge dang / dus ma yin pa 'chi ba dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa dang / duḥkha'i gnod pa thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /yul de ltas ngan zhig byung na yang mchod rten dang sangs rgyas kyis byin rlabs kyis 'od zer chen po byung bas ltas ngan dang / bkra mi shis pa thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig bsam pa ngan pas dmag dang chom rkun gyi gnod pa bya ba sems sam/ dgra rgo+ol ba zhig byung na yang / gnas der mchod rten de la 'od zer chen po 'byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis me lce kun tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i nang nas/

dmag gi dpung dang / mtshon cha'i char mngon par bstan pas/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad zhi zhing phyir bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams kyis kyang bsrung ba dang bskyabs par byas te/ phyogs bzhir dpag tshad brgya tshun chad du mtshams bcad de bsrung bas de'i nang du 'khrug pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / phyugs nad thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /'thab cing rtsod pa mi 'byung ngo / /chos ma yin par spyod pa med par 'gyur ro/ /'di la gsang sngags gzhan gyis bcad pa dang / mnan par mi nus te/ gsang sngags thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad la 'phral du 'grub par ci gnang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag par tshad mar gyur pa ji ltar stsal ba bzhin du/ bden pa mngon sum du bstan pa ci gnang / zhes lan gsum du gsol ba nan tan du gdab bo/ /de nas bsgrub bya la khro bo mnol ba med pa dang / bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgyas bsrung ba dang / go cha'i sngags kyis srung la/ go bskon pa byas la btang / de'i rjes su mchod pa po nang spos la gtang rag gi mchod pa dbul/ grub na sbyin sreg byas la bstod pa nas smon lam gdab pa'i bar dang / phyi rol tu phyogs kyi gtor ma sngar bzhin bya ba sogs rigs 'gre'o/ /de ni 'chi ba bsru ba'i cho ga'o/ /yang mchod rten gyi srog shing 'dzugs na/ sngon du bsnyen pa dang dkyil 'khor las rim gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ grogs dang lhan cig tu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gnas su sngon du bsnyen pa bya'o/ /de la dkon mchog gi rten dang khyad par 'di nyid kyi bris sku dang mchod pa sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs nas mtshams dam par bcad de/ thog mar nang par mal nas langs te/ gso sbyong blang la/ rigs gsum gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/

thal mo bkan pa las mdzub mo gnyis cung zad bkug ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam rgya mgo la gzhag la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ur+bha wa ye swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi'o/ /thal mo sbyar ba pad+ma kha phye ba'i tshul du byas te pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam rgya snying khar bzhag la/ oṃ pad+ma ur+bha ba ye swāhā/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi'o/ /thal mo ldog ste sbyar la mthe bong gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis sbyar nas rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam rgya lte ba'i thad du bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra ur+bha ba ye swāhā/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi'o/ /phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal bar bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya sogs phyag gi sngags rgya byas la/ bdag dbul bar bya ste/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag nyid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dus thams cad yongs ye 'bul na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis bdag bzhes su gsol/ bdag la dngos grub bla na med pa stsal du gsol/ khro bo mnol ba med pa'i sngags rgyas bsrung ba nas gzungs chu nang du sngags bzla ba'i bar gyi khrus rnams gong bzhin la sngags/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te na ba na ba sogs 'og nas 'byung ba'i sgrib sel gyi sngags nyer gcig bzlas la langs te gos gyon pa nas bzung rigs kyi snying po bzlas te rang gi spyi bor bsang gtor byas la bdag nyid sbyangs par gyur gyi bar gong bzhin/ de nas rten bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags kyis bsangs gtor bya ba nas bzung ku sha'i bsang byed srin lag g.yas la btags pa'i bar yang gong bzhin/ oṃ e bhan+dha swāhā/ ras kyi ze'u kha bcings par gyur/ yang / lus drang por bsrang ba nas bzung stong pa'i lha'i bar gong bzhin de las la su nas oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs 'og nas 'byung ba'i sgrib sel gyi sngags brjod la/

zhes pa'i/ sgra grags par gyur/ yang yi ge lha nas bzung gzugs kyi lha bskyed pa'i gcig tu gyur pa las zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel gser mdog thor tshugs dang cod paṇa can phyag na yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ gzugs kyi lha'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya gnas lngar gtugs pa nas bzung de las kyang rna'i drwa ba gzhan brgya stong bye ba snyed byung ba gyur gyi bar gong bzhin/ yang bla re'i sngags rgya dang / spyan 'dren gyi mchod yon sgrub pa nas mchod pas bdag la dges par mdzod kyi bar gong bzhin la sgrib sel gyi sngags kyi mthar/ sarba ṇi ba ra ṇa biskaṃ bhi ni a h+ye hi/ byang chub sems dpa' sgrib sel bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa mdun du byon par gyur/ sngar gyi mchod pa spyi'i phyag rgya la gnas pas/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'di ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs kyis thugs dpag mdzad du gsol/ /mchod yon gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bcas nas/ sgrib sel gyi sngags mthar/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ las kyi rdo rje pus btsugs mchod yon gyi phyag rgyas mchod yon dung chos bzung ste spyi bor sogs nas bzed zhal du dbul ba 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ mdun du bzhugs su gsol/ thal mo sbyar ba pad+ma kha phye ba'i tshul du byas pa las sor mo gsum rdo rje ltar byas pa rdo rje'i 'dug stangs gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra ā pa ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bos mthe chung gi sen mo mnan te ser mo lhag ma rnams rdo rje ltar byas pa'am tshig rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang / shaṃ ka re sa ma ye swāhā/ thal mo brkyang ba sbyar nas cung zad rtse mo bskum par byas pa sgrib sel gyi phyag rgya bstan la sgrib sel gyi gzungs brjod/

sor mo phan tshun sbyar te khu tshur bcang la gung mo bshibs pa'i phyi rol du mdzub mo rdo rje ltar byas nas mthe bong gnyis glo la sbyar ba ni/ dam tshig chen po'i phyag rgya ste de bcings te bskor ba bzhin du byas pa thams cad la bsrung ba chen por gyur/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs nas bzung rol mo 'bul ba'i bar gong bzhin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par sgrib sel gyi sngags kyi mthar mchod yon gyi sngags btags/ dri chab kyi gong du yang sgrib sel gyi sngags brjod do/ /mgon po thugs rje cher ldan pa/ /nas/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bar/ bstod pa 'byung ba'i sngags brjod/ 'jig rten dag gi phyogs kun na/ /nas/ skye ba dran zhing brtse ldan shog /gi bar gong bzhin la lan gsum brjod kyang 'gal ba med/ lha la nyer mchod dbul phreng ba rab gnas nas bzung snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la sgrib sel gyi sngags tshar gcig brjod/ sgra sngags kyi sogs nas rim pa 'dis gcig char gsal bar gyur par gong bzhin/ bzlas dus kyi bslab bya dang ldan pas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ na ba na ba tī naṃ/ samyak+saṃ bud+dha ko ṭi nā ma yu ta sha ta sa ha srā ṇi na maḥ sarba ṇi ba rā ṇa biskaṃ bhi ni bo dhi satwa ya/ oṃ ru ru ru ru/ ma ma sarba a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ni sarba ta thā ga ta ā yurba la bi su la nirma le/ sarba sid+dhi na maskri tā ba ra ba ra/ sarba satwa a wa lo ki ni/ oṃ sarba ṇi ba ra ṇa/ biskam+bhi ṇi/ ma ma sar+b+ba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni ku ru swāhā/ zhes sgrib sel gyi gzungs shib bur bzlas la bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad 'bum mam khri'o/ /thun re la bzlas pa ji tsam zin pa'i bar thun bsdu ba na bzlas pa phul la mchod pa bsangs sbyangs nas bzung bstod pa/ 'byung ba'i sngags brjod pa'i bar gong bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin la gshegs gsol gyi phyag rgya dang sgrib sel gyi sngags kyi mthar gats+tsha/

yang sgrib sel gyi sngags kyi mthar mchod yon gyi sngags rgya btags spyan drangs pa'i lha gzhal yas khang dang zhes pa nas 'dzag bsrung dang bla gos byin rlabs kyi bar kyang gong bzhin te bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor las rim la/ de ltar sngon du bsnyen pa song nas/ mchod rten chung ngu lta bu bum pa'i nang du dkyil 'khor mi shong ba'am/ bum pa dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa mi spro na/ mkhas grub khyung po lhas pas bshad pa bzhin/ mchod rten gyi nye logs su 'od zer dri med kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/ srog shing brtan pa'i cho ga bya/ lha rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa'i mchod rten bzhengs tshul du bshad pa bzhin/ gtsug tor dri med kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'od zer dri med kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas srog shing gi cho ga byas/ dkyil 'khor brtan bzhugs byas bzhugs pa ltar na bum rten dang / de'i khar bum ldir cung zad rtsegs mtho na srog shing 'dzugs pa dka' ba yong bas ran par brtsigs nas/ gtsug tor dri med kyi dkyil 'khor la bkab pa'i rdo leb kyi khar pa chog mchod rten gyi rmang 'ding skabs rgyas par grub pas/ ma byas kyang chad pa mi 'gyur snyam/ phyag len la sbyangs bzung tsam mdzad pa ltar na/ dbang chog las 'byung ba ltar la 'on kyang sgrib sel gyi bdag bskyed bya dgos pas khrus kyi skabs gtso bo'i sngags bzlas sogs la sgrib sel gyi sngags bzla'o/ /gzhan yang sa chog dang sta gon gyi bar dang sta gon gyi bar dang sta gon dang bris bzhengs kyi bar la zhag gis chod pa dang mchod pa'i rnam dbye rnams kyang gong bzhin shes par bya zhing las thig la ni gong bzhin dang tshom bu 'god skabs gtso bo'i g.yon du sgrib sel gyi tshom bu bkod/ snam bu'i mchod rdzas rnams 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin lha bskyed skabs bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon phyogs su gdan khri zlum po la pad zla'i steng du/

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sogs sgrib sel gyi gzungs dang / sgrib sel mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed/ gtso bo'i g.yas su spyan gzigs dang / sgrib sel gyi g.yon du phyag rdor bskyed/ 'jig rten pa rnams gong bzhin bskyed pa nas/ gzungs gtso bo'i spyan 'dren gyi mchod yon rdzogs nas bh+rūṃ dang / sgrib sel gyi gzungs kyi mthar sarba ṇaṃ wa nas hi bar dang / bde ba gshegs so nas mdzod/ sgrib sel gyi gzungs mthar mchod yon gyi sngags btags la mchod yon snying kha nas shar du 'bul/ spyan gzigs spyan 'dren pa nas bzung gtso bo la mchod pa sum 'gyur 'bul ba'i bar gong bzhin la/ de nas sgrib sel la mchod pa tshar gnyis/ bsang ba'i skabs de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs snying gis bsangs spyan gzigs la mchod pa 'bul ba nas bzung snyan gsan dbab pa'i mthar bstod pa rdzogs pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba sgrib sel gyi gzungs kyang bzla/ phyag rdor gyi bstod pa'i rjes su/ lha yi dbang po nye dbang po/ /stobs ldan sa gsum dbang byed cing / /'jug pa bcu yis rnam par rol/ /lha chen sred med bu la bstod/ /mthu chen srid pa kun gyi gtso/ /sngon sangs rgyas kyang 'jig rten 'dir/ /thabs mkhas mthu yis mu stegs 'dul/ /lha chen drag po khyed la bstod/ /zhi zhing rnam par sgeg pa'i lus/ /yid bzhin rin chen rgyan 'chang zhing / /bde gshegs bstan la dad cing gus/ /tshogs zhes grags pa khyed la bstod/ /bstod pas 'byung ba'i sngags brjod/ gshegs gsol nas bkra shis kyi rjes su mdo 'don pa'i bar gong bzhin/ thig tshon byin rlabs ni gong sor bzhag mtshan ma 'god pa'i skabs 'khor lo'i g.yon du khri zlum po dang pad zla'i steng du nor bu dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su srog shing gi gdan pad dkar 'dab brgyad lte ba yangs pa/ gzhan rnams gong bzhin/ srog shing tshad ldan shug pa bzang po 'go 'jug ma log pa gru bzhi rtse rim gyi cung phra ba/

de'i bya spyod kyi gzungs kris pa'i thad du phyogs bzhir gzungs khung brus la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te na ba na ba sogs sgrib sel gyi gzungs tshar dgu cu go dgu bcug srog shing gi rtse mo'i nang du brus la/ 'od zer dri med kyi gzungs ril po/ bla ma'i sku gdung dang ring bsrel dbu skra sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs rnams bcug srog shing gi rtsa ba brus par/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma la mi she sogs 'od zer dri med kyi snying po dang / rten 'brel snying po bcug gzungs thams cad la dri bzang byugs zhabs nas bsgril bu lugs 'di ltar bzhed kyang / sa lugs la 'di 'thad do/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i sdom gsum kha skong las/ rten gyi nang gzungs bsgril tshe/ /phar cher mtha' nas bsgril ba mthong / /de tshe oṃ sogs sngags kyi 'go /phyi ru 'byung zhing sngags mjug rnams/ /dbus su 'byung phyir 'di yis ni/ /phyi nang rten 'brel kun la gnod/ /'go nas bsgril na sngags kyi 'go /dbus su 'byung phyir blang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs yang / bu ston mkhas grub gzhan dang mi 'dra bas/ de'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa rnams bu ston rang gi dgongs pa bzhin dang / rang cag sa lugs rnams kun mkhyen chen pa'i dgongs pa bzhin lag len bgyis pas 'thus so// na bza' ser pos brgyan/ gdung ring bsrel rnams la'ang sku khrus gsol/ dri bzang dang lhan du na bzas dril gzungs kyis dkris/ slar yang na bza' bzang pos brgyan/ de thams cad la sbyang khrus sngon du 'gro ba'i rab gnas bsdus pa byas/ gzungs zhugs rnams kyi nang du yang dri bzang pos byugs/ gu gul gyis bdug par dbu zhabs ma log par/ oṃ yan+t+ra dha tu gar+bhā ya swāhā/ zhes bzla zhing bzhugs su gsol/ sgo rnams dam par bkag bsrub mi mngon par byas srog shing tshon dmar pos byugs/ srog shing gi bre'i thas ka'i phyogs bzhir/

rig pa chen mo'i sngags oṃ sarba bad+yī swāhā/ zhes dang / bre ba'i gdong dang / mgul dang thugs ka'i thad du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ aṃ zhes dang srog shing gi 'go mjug thams cad la srog shing brtan pa'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ zhes pa rnams lañcar bris zhing / khyad par thugs ka'i thad du yi ge che zhing zab par bya/ de rnams dang / phyi nas dkri rgyu'i gzungs sogs la'ang sbyang khrus rab gnas byas nas bla ma'i mtshan gzungs/ rgyud sde'i gzungs sogs srog shing la dkri 'os pa rnams go rim ma log par dkris pa'i phyi nas mchod sprin gyi gzungs dang na bza' ser pos khyab par dam par dkris/ de lta bu'i srog shing de la yang sbyang khrus/ rab gnas byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcugs/ phyogs bzhi nas thag pas 'then/ ka sgrom lta bus ya yo mi yong ba bya/ phyi'i snam bu'i grwa bzhir pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad bri/ de'i steng du dri chus gang ba'i dung chos re re bzhag shar gyi snam bu'i steng du spos sna tshogs 'thul ba'i spos snod lnga'am/ ting phor spos sna tshogs kyis bkang ba gsum mam gang 'byor bzhag lho'i snam bu la dri'i chus gang ba'i dung chos dang / me tog gis gang ba'i snod dang / 'bras sam 'bras bu'i bkang ba bzhag nub kyi snam bu la til nag dang / ma sha dang 'bras bsres nas btsos pa'i thug pa kri pa ra dang / zas dkar gsum rnams bum par blug pa dang / shing thog sna tshogs 'bras bu dgu cu rtsa dgu rnams dgod/ byang gi snam bu la kha zas sna tshogs sbyar ba'i gtor ma dang / dri'i chus gang ba'i bum pa mgul chings kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ spos dang me tog rnams bzhag nub byang gi grwar dri'i dung chos kyi rgyab tu shing zla gam gzugs lta bu/ de'i steng du mar me'i skong bu ba nag chog pa'i ngos la/ tshogs bdag glang po'i gdong can dkar po/ dgra satwa dang la phug 'dzin pa bris la/ de'i spyi bo'i steng du mar me bzhag

de ltar dkyil 'khor bkod nas/ mtha' dri bzang dang snum bsres pas cha chen gcig gi rgya tsam byugs/ mchod pa bcu bsham pa nas bzung bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs ci 'byor gyis bskor ba'i bar gyis shom rnams khro bo mnol ba med pa'i sngags rgyas bsrung ba nas bzung sgrib sel gyi bdag bskyed byas nas/ brgya stong bye ba stong gyur bar gyur gyi bar gong bzhin dang / pad+mo'i steng du gzhal yas khang bskyed pa nas bzung sems bskyed kyi rjes su mdo 'don pa'i bar dkyil chog bzhin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gtso bo skyed tshar ba'i rjes su bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon du gdan gyi khri zlum po la pad zla'i steng du yid bzhin gyi nor bu sgrib sel gyi sngags dang dzi na dzika nor bu de nyid byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel nas sems pa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /bar dang / spyan 'dren mchod pa la'ang sgrib sel bcug phyag rgya bstan pa'i skabs su gtso bo'i sngags rgya rdzogs nas sgrib sel gyi sngags rgya bya ba rnams khyad par tsam las gzhan thams cad gong dkyil chog bzhin no/ /mchod rten gyi phyogs bzhir mdzes pa'i stegs kyi steng du/ mchod bya'i g.yon nas mgo brtsams pa'i mchod yon sogs mchod pa rgyas par bshams/ de'i mdun du stegs bu'i khar rin po che'i snod so sor dkar gtor zlum po brgyad dang / dmar gtor gcig bsdu na spyir gcig bshams pa chab gtsang gis bran/ mchod rten shar phyogs su dpon slob tshang ma mchod rten la zhal phyogs pas bzhengs/ rdo dril/ sil snyan rnga dkar dung la sogs pa sta gon byas te/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang sems brgyad/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon brgyad dang / gsang ba'i bdag po rgyal chen bzhi/ tshangs pa/ dbang phyug khyab 'jug rnams mngon sum du byon par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de rnams la dmigs pas/

bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa la sogs pa shar phyogs gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes dngos su phyag 'tshal/ de bzhin du rigs 'gre sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen tog la sogs pa lho phyogs kyi 'od dpag med la sogs pa/ nub phyogs kyi rnga sgra la sogs pa/ byang phyogs kyi ting nge 'dzin glang po dam pa'i dpal la sogs pa/ byang shar gyi pad+mo dam pa'i dpal la sogs pa/ shar lho'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dam pa'i dpal la sogs pa/ lho nub gyi gdugs dam pa la sogs pa/ nub byang gi rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa/ 'og phyogs kyi ye shes kyi 'od zer la sogs pa/ steng phyogs kyi/ da ltar bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa gdul bya'i dbang gis 'dzam bu gling 'dir mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par rol pa sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don du mdzad cing bzhugs pa laྎ 'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po brgyad laྎ gnod sbyin gyi dbang po nor bu bzang po la sogs pa gdon sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgyad laྎ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / rnam thos kyi bu la/ tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / sred med kyi bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes dngos su phyag byas/ rgyas yan/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma'i tshigs bcad du sbyar ba'am/ bsdu na/ nyer mchod sngags rgyas mchod/ shin tu spro na/ pu rang kyi rten 'brel don lhan gar dbyangs bcas pa bya/ stan la 'khod de gtor ma sngar bzhin byin gyi brlabs/ yak+ṣa zhes pas gnod sbyin dang / oṃ dhṛ d+dha rāṣ+ṭa ye/ oṃ bi ru dha ka ye/ oṃ ba ru pāk+ṣa ye/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ye/ zhes phyogs bzhi skyong ba dang /

sogs khong nas bra ha ma ṇa ye/ ī shwa ra/ bi ṇu tshangs dbang / sred med bu rnams la sngags/ de rnams re re'i mthar/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sogs btags pa gsum gsum gyis phul/ kha dog ldan zhing sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis gnod sbyin dang / rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa sogs rgyal chen bzhis bstod pa dang / ngang pa'i rgyal po la gnas pa/ /gser mdog gdong bzhi pad+ma dang / /bsgrang phreng ghun+dhe glegs bam 'dzin/ /skye dgu'i chen po la phyag 'tshal/ /mthu chen srid pa kun gyi sogs/ /lha yi dbang po nye dbang po/ /sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ bi pu la bi ma le/ sogs 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags nyi shu rtsa brgyad brjod la/ pus mo btsugs/ thar mo sbyar nas bdug spos 'dzin bzhin pas/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang / khyad par du dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgyad dang / rgyal po chen po sde bzhi dang / tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / sred med gyi bu la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi gzungs las 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin 'phags pa gdan 'dzom par mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhes su gsol te/ 'phags pa rnams spyan drangs nas mchod cing gsol ba btab pa dang / mchod rten gyi srog shing btsug pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis 'phags pa thams cad kyis mchod rten chos kyi sku ru byin gyis brlabs te/ ring bsrel dang ldan par mdzad nas mchod rten la mchod pa dang / rim gro byed cing srog shing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ che bdag cag gi sbyin bdag gshin gson ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas tshe ring zhing nad med pa dang /

bar chad kyi bgegs thams cad dang bral ba dang / mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / dge bsnyen ma gang la la zhig gi bsod nams kyi 'bras bu chen po thob cing yon tan thob par 'dod pas gsang sngags kyi rgyal pos cho ga sngar bstan pa bzhin du byas te/ dgu cu rtsa dgu yi ger bris la sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten gyi mdun du dkyil 'khor gru bzhir byas la bas gci bas byugs te/ grwa bzhir dri'i chu phor bu bkang ba re re bzhag bdug spos kyi snod 'thul ba yang bzhag nas/ snod chen po'i nang du me tog dang / dri'i chu dang / 'bras skam po rnams blugs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag pa dang / yang til nag po dang / sran ma ma sha dang / 'bras rnams brtsos pas 'bras thugs kri pa ra zhes bya ba dang / zas dkar gsum dang 'di rnams bum pa'i nang du blugs pa dang / yang shing tog sna tshogs pa 'bras bu dgu cu rtsa dgu dang / kha zas ming gi smos pa 'di rnams dang / spos dang me tog la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bkram la gsang sngags kyi yi ge mchod rten gyi srog shing gi nang du bcug nas/ mchod rten phyogs bzhir phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon sum du dmigs te phyag byas la sems rtse gcig pas gsang sngags 'di dag 'don par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ oṃ bi pu la bi ma le/ pra ba ra dzi na sa re/ sa ra sa ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta dhā tu gar+dhe/ a dhiṣ+ṭha te swāhā/ a ya ta ro ba ṇi swāhā/ sarba de ba ṇa/ ba ha ya bi shūd+dhā dhiṣ+ṭha na sa ma ye swāhā/ bdug spos 'thul ba rgyun mi chad par bya zhing / gsang sngags lan nyi shu rtsa brgyad bton na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' brgyad dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgyad dang /

gsang ba'i bdag po dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / sred med kyi bu rnams de'i mod la mchod rten de la mchod pa dang / rim gro byed pa dang / srog shing brtan par byed do/ /de bas gang du yang sangs rgyas bye ba 'bum phrag dgu cu rtsa dgu dang / gaṅgā'i rlung gi bye ma rnyed kyang gnas der gshegs te/ mchod rten de la mchod pa dang / chos kyis skur byin gyis rlob cing ring bsrel dang ldan par mdzad do/ /de ltar sems thag pa nas cho ga tshul bzhin du byas na yon tan de dag dang / gzhan yang mchod rten de yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che las byas pa'i bsod nams thob par 'gyur te/ rin po che'i rnam pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma las mchod rten byas pa dang 'dra bar 'gyur te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po dang ldan zhing lus rnam par dag la tshe ring zhing nad med pa dang / bgegs thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /gang gzhan la la zhig mchod rten 'di mthong ngam/ mchod rten de'i dril bu'i sgra thos na yang las kyi sgrib pa dang / sdig pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur te/ 'tshams med pa lnga byas pa yang yongs su byang nas 'chi ba'i dus byed pa'i 'og tu bde ba can gyi 'jigs rten du skye'o/ /gang la la zhig gis mchod rten de'i ming tsam thos pa yang 'chi ba'i dus byas nas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam thob par 'gyur/ tha na bya dang ri dwags la sogs pa'i sems can gang gis mthong ba de yang tshe 'phos nas dud 'gro'i skye gnas spangs te/ bsod nams dang ldan pa'i lus thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bka' stsal pa'i phan yon thams cad che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad la 'phral du 'grub par ci gnang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag par tshad mar gyur pas ji ltar bka' stsal pa bzhin du bden pa mngon sum du bstan pa ci gnang / zhes lan gsum du gsol ba nan tan du gdab/

de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ khyab 'jug rnams mngon sum du byon par gyur ces dang / phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba nan tan du gdab pa'i bar mchod rten gyi lho/ nub byang nas kyang byas la 'jug tu/ shar phyogs nas/ smi ngan 'jigs dang sdig pa thams cad zhi ba byed pa nas/ 'gro ba rnams su byang chub spyod par shog gi bar/ gtsug tor dri med nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod pas/ bkra shis dang smon lam bya zhing / gzhan yang bkra shis rgya cher brjod cing / rol mo sna tshogs dkrol/ me tog gi char dbab bo/ /de nas rjes chog ni/ mchod pa gsar pa bshams la bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs sogs dkyil chog bzhin la dkyil 'khor la rten bzhugs bya/ bkra shis rdzogs nas mdo 'don pa'i bar gong bzhin/ de nas dkyil 'khor de la zhal kheb bkab nas bum pa'i 'phro brtsegs/ de'i bar la gnas khang yangs por dri med tsha tsha'i rab gnas kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang rung bzhengs nas/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twas mdzad pa'i sāts+tsha'i cho ga chog khrigs thugs sras sems dpa' chen po rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa bzhin dus rtag par bya ba'am/ yang na mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i gsung rab bzhin nged rang nas chog bsgrigs zhig slar bgyid 'dod yod pa grub na de bzhin no/ /nang bzhugs gzhan rnams la'ang sbyangs khrus rab gnas byas/ de nas bum pa'i nang du gu gul gyis bdug nas/ spos dang me tog gi gdan bkram/ kha stong min par dkar gsum sogs btung ba'i zas la longs spyad nas/ spos sna/ dar gdugs/ rol mo sogs kyis sku gsung thugs rten mdo rgyud tsha tsha sogs bum pa'i nang du gzhag rgyu thams cad nye logs su spyan drangs/ slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ slar yang brten rnams bum pa'i nang dang bcas pa'i sbyangs pa byas mthar bden brdar ye shes sems dpa'i phyi 'brang gi bgegs rnams bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/

drag sngags rol mo drag tu bya/ las kyi rdo rjes gu gul gyis bdug de ltar bgegs bsal ba yid ches par byas nas/ bum pa'i nang gi phyogs bzhir go rim dang / dbu zhabs ma log par bzhugs su gsol/ mchod bstod/ brtan bzhugs dang / bkra shis brjod nas/ de dag la bla bre dang thog bzang po phub/ de nas bre rten brtsigs la/ gan+dzi ra/ dril bum nyi zla'i gzugs gang yin 'dzug dus gdugs dkar gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzug pa'i cho ga bya ba ni srog shing 'dzug pa'i cho ga'o/ /yang tshogs rdzogs shing sdig pa dag par 'dod pas/ bsnyen pa nas dkyil 'khor grub mchod kyi bar bstan ma thag pa dang 'dra ba byas la/ sngar gyi srog shing gis sngags dang / snying po'i sngags dang sgrib pa rnam sel gyi gzungs dang / srog shing brtan par byed pa'i gzungs bzhi po re re bzhin dgu cu rtsa dgu bris la/ de'i nang du bcug pa'i tsha tsha dgu bcu rtsa dgu byas te 'og nas 'chad pa'i na mo nā ba tī naṃ la sogs pa'i sngags bris la/ mchod rten gyi 'phang lo'i nang du gzhug dkyil 'khor gyi snam bu'i steng na mar bzhugs su gsol/ dkyil 'khor du shong ba med na dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du pad+ma'i gdan byas la bzhugs su gsol/ zhi ba snying po'i gzhung ngam/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twas gzhung bzhin du mchod rten gyi mnga' gsol dang mchod pa rgya cher bya/ bskor ba lan bdun bya zhing 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags na mo na ba la sogs pa brgya rtsa'am dgu bcu rtsa dgu bton la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / 'phags pa chos skyong ba'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi gzungs nas 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/

'phags pa rnams gdan 'dzoms pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'phags pa rnams spyan drangs nas mchod cing bstod nas bzlas brjod bgyis pa dang / gsang sngags bzhi po re re zhing nang du bcug pa'i mchod rten dgu bcu rtsa dgu bgyis te/ gsang sngags yi ge bris nas mchod rten gyi 'phang lor bcug pa'i mchod rten bgyis te mchod cing bstod nas bskor ba byas shing / gzungs bzlas pa'i mthus che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing gnod pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi nas phan bde bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i dngos grub stsal ba ci gnang / sngon gsang ba'i bdag po la dpal gyi mgur nas 'di skad du/ gang la la zhig pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par spyod pa 'dod pa des snga ma bzhin du dkyil 'khor gru bzhi par byas te/ sa dang lci bas byug la de'i steng du spos kyi skyang nul gyis byugs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhir dri'i chus gang ba'i snod re re bzhag la sngar bstan pa'i gsang sngags bzhi po dag las rnam par gcig kyang dgu bcu rtsa dgu bris te/ rang gis lag gis mchod rten chung ngu dgu bcu rtsa dgu gdab cing gsang sngags rnams gcig kyang rere'i nang du gzhug go /de nas yang gsang sngags 'di dgu bcu rtsa dgu yi ger bris te mchod rten gyi 'phang lo rnams kyi nang du bcug la/ mchod rten rnams dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag ste/ me tog dang byugs pas mchod pa lan bdun bdun bskor zhing gsang / 'di yang gdon par bya'o/ /na mo nā ba nā ti naṃ ta thā ga ta gaṃ gā nā dī na la kāṃ/ ko ṭi ni yu ta sha ta pa pra ṇaṃ/ oṃ so so ri/ tsa ri ṇi tsa/ ri mo ri ko ri tsa la ba ri swāhā/ cho ga 'di ltar byas na pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par spyad pa yang ma zad do/ /des ni rin po che'i mchod rten bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gaṅgā'i rlung gi bye ma snyed byas par 'gyur ro/

/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phyag dgu cu rtsa dgu snyed la mchod cing bsnyen bkur byas par 'gyur ro/ /de'i gang du lha thams cad kyi mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs bsdus te mchod rten de la yo byad sna tshogs sbyar nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang dang / yo byad sna tshogs sbyar nas mchod par 'gyur te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de snyed kyi mkhyen cing gzigs te byin gyis rlobs par mdzad do/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po'i bsod nams dang yon tan thams cad thob par mdzad do/ /yang gang la la zhig gis gsang sngags kyis rgyal po'i snying po 'di ma nor bar yi ger bris la rtag tu bton te/ mchod pa'i las byas la lus la thogs na rig pa de nyid kyi bsrung ba dang / skyabs par mdzad do/ /phas kyi rgol ba'i dgra thams cad dang / sha gnyer ba rnams dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dwags la sogs pa thams cad kyang gnod par mi 'gyur te/ 'jigs shing skrag nas so sor 'byer bar 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig gi rig pa 'don pa de dang / gtam byas pa yang mtshams med pa lnga'i las kyi sgrib pa yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig gis sngags pa des sgra thos sam grib ma phog gam/ lus la reg kyang rung ste/ de'i tshe rabs gzhan gyis las kyi sgrib pa dang / sdig pa thams cad yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gang rig pa 'don pa de'i lus la dug gis mi tshugs/ mes mi tshugs/ chus 'khyer bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gdon thams cad kyis kyang glags mi snyed/ thog 'bab par mi 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bsrung ba dang skyabs par mdzad cing / spyan ras kyis 'tsho bar mdzad do/ /lha thams cad dang dam tshig can thams cad kyis kyang de la stong grogs byed par 'gyur te/ gzhan gyis rig sngags dang / byad dang sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/

/de lta bas na rig pa 'don pa gnas gang na 'dug kyang gsang sngags 'di'i cho ga don du gnyer bar bya ste gsang sngags yi ger bris la/ lam gyi gzhi mdo'am/ sum mdo/ skye bo mang po phan tshun 'gro ba'i gnas su mchod rten byas la/ de'i nang du bcug na/ 'gro ba thams cad dang / bya dang / sbrang ma dang / tha na grogs sbur yan chad kyis/ mthong ba dang / thos pa dang / reg pa dang / de la phog pa'i sa dang / rdul dang / rlung dang / grib ma phog na yang byol song dang / yi dwags dang / ngan song log par ltung ba dang / sems can dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur ba'i sdig pa thams cad dang bral zhing / 'chi ba'i dus byas na bde 'gro mtho ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur te/ sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa yongs su byang bas tshe rabs rjes su dran pa thob par 'gyur zhing phyir mi ltung ba'i chos can du 'gyur ro/ /zhes bka' stsal pa'i phan yon thams cad che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad la 'phral du 'grub par ci gnang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag par tshad mar gyur pas/ ji ltar bka' stsal pa bzhin du bden pa mngon sum du bstan par ci gnang / zhes lan gsum la sogs pa nan tan du gdab bo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mjug gi cho ga thams cad snga ma dang 'dra ba yin te/ tshogs bsags pa'i cho ga'o/ /bya rgyud rin chen 'byung gnas nas/ /'od zer dri med nor bu blangs/ /spyi rgyud bzhi yis byi dor byas/ /legs bshad rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pa'i/ /dge bas 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /rnam grol rin chen gling gi bdag /yon tan ro 'dzin nyis stong ldan/ /kun mkhyen gding can 'grub gyur cig /'di la nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na/ /bla ma rnams dang lhag pa'i lha/ /bya ba'i rgyud la mkhas rnams kyis/ /bzod pa'i me yi gzhom du gsol/ /'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi gzungs las dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gsungs pa la/

slob dpon byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa'i bya ba spyi'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa dang / bya ba spyi'i rgyud rnam pa bzhi nas kha skang zhing ma tshang ba dag 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang don zhags cho ga zhib mo dang / phyag rdor rigs mchog gi rgyud la sogs pa bya ba'i rgyud sde chen po rnams nas cung zad kha skang ste/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas bsgrig par mdzad pa'i 'od zer dri med kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'chi med 'byung ba dang / rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa'i de'i lhan thabs mun sel nyin byed snang ba dang / kha skong bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dang / dri med rnam gnyis kyi cho ga zung 'brel rnams la gzhi brten nas sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang dang skal ba mnyam pa rnams la phan pa'i bsams pas nag 'gros bklag chog gi tshul du bkod pa la rang bzo'i dri ma phra mo tsam med kyang bdag blo rmongs pas 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na dpyod ldan gzur gnas chos kyi 'dren byed gsal ba rnams kyis zhus dag par mdzad du gsol/ 'dis 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por myur du skem par gyur cig/ //shū bhaṃ// ༈ /swa sti/ yang 'di'i phyi rol gtor ma'i skabs phyogs gtor byed na/ shar du gtor ma sha chang sgog gtsong la phug rnams kyis brgyan pa dang / dri chab nas mar me'i bar gyi mchod pa bshams/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs nang gtor bzhin la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra a na la ha da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ a ka ro mu khaṃ sogs mchod gtor lha rdzas kyis bsam gyis mi khyab par gzi byin bskyed par gyur/ mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ 'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan dang / /log 'dren sna yon mdung thung dang / /gshol mda' can dang gtun shing dang / /'khrugs byed rnam dag yang dag 'gugs/ /'byung po 'khor lo can la sogs/

/mchod gtor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ bhū ta ya a dhi pa ta ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ya hi/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas spyan 'dren dang gdan phul/ yang sngar gyi sngags kyi sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su/ na maḥsarba nas khā hi swāhā'i bar brjod la rdor thal se gol dang bcas pa gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ ā ha ra sogs bzhis mchod/ 'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan dang / /zhes/ 'byung po 'khor lo can la sogs/ /'byung po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /sa sa swo swor gtor ma phul ba 'di/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas kyang / /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ /rang gi bud med mdza' bshes gnyen mdun dang / /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang byug pa bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul gyis/ /'di dag btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma la sogs snying po brjod/ tshangs pa brgya byin dbang phyug che/ /khyab 'jug lha klu gnod sbyin sogs/ /ded dpon brgyad po 'khor bcas dang / 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /bdag gis khrus dang me tog dang / /spos dang mar me byug pa dang / /zhal zas sna tshogs khyed la 'bul/ /khyed kyis dpal dang brtson 'grus dang / /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis ni/ /nad dang gnod pa bsal nas kyang / /bdag cag rnams la bkra shis mdzod/ /shar phyogs su bdag dang sems can thams cad bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ zhes brjod la gtor ma btang / gong gi sngags kyi mjug tu gats+tsha btags pas gshegs su gsol/ lho phyogs su gtor ma zhag dang sha khrag gis brgyan pa dang / mchod pa bshams te bsangs ba sogs gong bzhin la/ ma mo chen mo 'dzin ma dang / /rdo rje gzhon nu lu gu rgyud/
