/pad+mo'i mig dang rig gser phreng / /rdo rje shugs ldan mdangs ldan ma/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'od phreng ma/ /ma mo'i gdon tshogs thams cad kun/ /mchod gtor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma tri ga naṃ bh+yaḥs pa ri wā ra e sogs spyan 'dren dang / gdan 'bul gtor bsngo mchod pa tshig bcad thams cad gong 'dra la/ mtshan sngags dmigs bsal sbyar zhing / ma mo'i tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /zhes dang / lho phyogs su bdag dang zhes sogs dang / mtshan sngags kyi mthar gats+tsha brjod/ nub tu gtor ma dkar gsum dmar gsum gyis brgyan pa dang mchod pa bshams/ bsangs ba sogs cho ga thams cad gong bzhin la/ klu rgyal dga' bo nye dga' bo/ /mtha' yas 'jog po stobs kyi rgyu/ /rigs ldan dung skyong pad+ma dang / /chu lha nor rgyas la sogs pa/ /klu chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mchod gtor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sogs spyan 'dren gdan 'bul gtor bsngo mchod pa tshig bcad thams cad 'dra ba la/ mtshan sngags dmigs bsal dang / klu yi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /ces dang / nub phyogs su bdag dang zhes sogs dang / mtshan sngags kyis mthar gats+tsha brjod/ byang du gtor ma dkar gsum gyis brgyan pa dang mchod pa bshams bsang ba sogs cho ga thams cad gong bzhin la/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba nas/ mchod kyi gshegs su gsol gyi bar/ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e sogs spyan 'dren dang / gdan 'bul gtor bsngo mchod pa thams cad gong bzhin la/ mtshan sngags dmigs bsal sbyar zhing / dbang po rdo rje nas/ dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal gyi bar dang / dbang po sogs dang / 'bras bu mchis par mdzod nas/ gzungs brjod/ tshangs pa brgya byin sogs gong bzhin la/ phyogs skyong tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /zhes dang / byang phyogs bdag dang zhes sogs dang / mtshan sngags kyi mthar gats+tsha brjod/

nye reg byas nas shar du log pa ni phyogs gtor ro/ /yang bsdus pa byed na/ dpung bzang las/ de ltar gdon la mchod pa byas nas su/ /de nas phyogs skyong rnams la mchod par byed/ /zhes pas sgrub khang gi phyir dor te/ gtor ma gnyis mchod pa dang bcas pa nang gtor bzhin bsang ba sogs byin rlabs nas/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nas/ gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir spyon cig /ces gdon gyi rigs smos pa'i sgo nas spyan drongs/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /nas/ las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces gnas smos pa'i sgo nas mchod gtor phul te 'phrin las gsol/ de ltar gdon la thog mar mchod pa bya ba ni de dag gtum zhing myur du 'tshe ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes yo ṭīka yid bzhin nor bur gsungs/ phyogs skyong la/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /nas/ bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces phrin las gzhol/ oṃ in+d+ra ya swāhā/ sogs phyogs skyong gi sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+ya sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags btags pa gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang pa'i lha/ /nas/ dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas bstod cing phrin las gzhol/ las kyi rdo rjes mchod pa rnams mas rim gyis gtor ma'i thog tu blug nas/ slob dpon gyi mchod yon phyed gtor ma'i 'og la/ phyed kyis gtor lam phyed/ sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha/ las sngags/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags/ rol mo drag po/ nyi ma nub nas dpal 'bar bcas/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor/ bgegs rnams la yang gtor ma sbyin no/ /zhes pa'i don/ mkhas pa'i dbang po tsan+d+ra shrīs/ sde brgyad dang bgegs kyis gnod pa med phyirabatags pa yin/

zhes gsungs pa 'thus/ 'di'i dbang bskur gyis skabs slob ma sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis char rin chen bsod nams mchog grub gyi kha skong bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun sor bzhag la/ bzlas lung yan chad tshar mtshams su/ mchod g.yog gis dkyil 'khor gyi shar na dkyil 'khor la kha phyogs par lang nas/ de nas g.yon du khrus long dkyil 'khor gyi gzugasabarnyan 'char ba khrus gzhong bcas pa dang / g.yas pas bum pa thogs/ phrag pa g.yas la khrus ras/ g.yon la gos zung dpyangs/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyis ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o/ /zhes snyan sgron/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang / /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs slad du/ /rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas/ shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i gsung la 'gags pa mi mnga' yang / /sems can ngag gi sgrib pa sbyangs slad du/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /sems can ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba nas shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs la 'khrul pa mi mnga' yang / /sems can yid kyi sgrib pa sbyangs slad du/ /rgyal ba'i thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /sems can yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba nas shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang /

/sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba nas shrī hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni/ /rol mo bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba nas shrī hūm̐/ zhes sngags brjod dus me long la khrus gsol dang rol mo bya'o/ /de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku dbyi'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes sku sha'i khrus ras kyi dbus dang phyogs bzhir dri'i yi ge 'god tshul bya/ kā ya bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ zhes khrus ras kyis sku dbyi tshul bya/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas par ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ zhes ku shas dri byugs tshul bya/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /nas/ oṃ badz+ra wa sa ye swāhā/ zhes gos zung dbul lo/ /khrus gsol ba'i chu slar las bum du blugs/ des sdig sgrib sogs bkrus par mos te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma la sogs snying po dang / las sngags dang / bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags bzlas la rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ nad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ rims thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ gdon thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ mkhon thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ grib thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ byad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ byur thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/

skal pa ngan pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ ltas ngan pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ mtshan mo nag mo'i gdon thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ dus kyi zhags pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ yang ku sha dang rma bya'i sgros byabs nas/ snying po dang las sngags bdud rtsi thabs sbyor rnams bzlas pa'i mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa nā ye swāhā/ zhes shān+tiṃ ku ru'i tshab la a pa nā sogs bcug nas/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad a pa nā ye swāhā/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyis bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / yi dam rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du bcom ldan 'das 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig las sngags dang bdud rtsi thabs sbyor bzlas/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo drag po bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las so/ /dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal/ /dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal/ /lha min zla ba rnams las rgyal/ /nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal bar gyur/ /rlung ni sprin las rgyal bar gyur/

/rdo rje yi ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden pa rab tu gnas/ /sa yang bden par gnas pa lags/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden/ /bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags/ /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig 'di dag gis/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal par gyur cig dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ lus kyi spyi bo mdun rgyab dpung pa g.yas g.yon pus mo g.yas g.yon te gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram tu bzhag ste snying po las sngags bdud rtsi thabs sbyor rnams kyi mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥ de bzhin du sngar gyi shān+tiṃ ku ru'i tshab la rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥbacug nas bgegs dang log pa 'dren pa thams cad las rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥ bkra shis rdzas rtags las sngags dang / bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis rdzas rtags rang rang gi mthu nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la gsang sngags dang rigs kyi bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs dkar phyag tu phul bas skye 'gro rnams la bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad bcom ste/ mthu stobs phun sum tshogs pas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis rlabs pa de bzhin du deng 'dir bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la yungs dkar gyi rdzas kyi bkra shis par gyur cig yungs dkar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa yi/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des ni bgegs rnams zhi bar shog /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la bram ze kun+ḍa lis dur ba phyag tu phul bas/ 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob ste bkra shis pa'i rdzas su nas/

bcas pa rnams las dur ba'i rdzas kyis bkra shis par gyur cig dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrub nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel bar shog /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgya shākya thub pa la/ shing gi lha mos shing thog bil ba phyag tu phul bas/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad grub ste/ byang chub kyi snying po mchog tu gyur nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su nas/ rnams la bil ba'i rdzas kyi bkra shis par gyur cig bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub par shog /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ glang po che nor skyong gi gi waṃ phyag tu phul bas/ nyon mongs dug gsum gyi sgrib pa bcad de/ bla na med pa'i sman du gyur nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su nas/ rnams la gi wang gi rdzas kyis bkra shis par gyur cig gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med pa gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal zhi bar shog /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sa yi lha mo bstan mas sman li khri phyag tu phul bas/ sa'i bcud thams cad bsdus te thams cad dbang du gyur nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su nas/ rnams la li khris rdzas kyis bkra shis par gyur cig li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus nas kyang / /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas ba nyis stong gi 'o ma'i nying khu bsdus pa'i zho phyag tu phul bas/

bcud thams cad kyi snying po bsdus te yon tan gyi dbyings su gyur nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su nas/ rnams la zho'i rdzas kyis bkra shis par gyur cig zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes mchog rtogs nas/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul bas/ kun gzhi rnam par shes par gnas gyur te me long lta bu'i ye shes su grub nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su nas/ rnams la me long gi rdzas kyis bkra shis par gyur cig me long ye shes chen po'i rgya mtsho yis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur nas/ /rnam dag chos la thog med spyod pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub ba la/ lha'i dbang po brgya sbyin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu phul bas/ skye 'gro rnams la bla na med pa'i chos bstan te/ ngag gi mchog grub nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dung gi rdzas kyis bkra shis par gyur cig dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston byed pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig dbang thob par shog /ces bkra shis rdzas rnams mgo la reg de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad gtad pa ni/ gdugs byin la/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni/ /lag na gdugs bzang gser gyi yu ba can/ /thogs nas rgyal ba'i dbu la mchod pa ltar/ /dbu la gdugs kyi bkra shis thob par shog /oṃ maṅga la tsha traṃ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ de 'gre/ bkra shisྎ /lag na gser gyi nya mo 'od 'bar ba/

/thogs nas rgyal ba'i spyan laྎ /spyan la nya yiྎ /mañcaྎ bkra shisྎ /phyag na pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad pa/ /thogs nas rgyal ba'i ljags laྎ /ljags la pad+mo'iྎ /pad+moྎ bkra shisྎ /phyag na rin chen bum pa yongs gang ba/ /thogs nas rgyal ba'i mgul laྎ /mgul la bum pa'iྎ /kum+bhaྎ bkra shisྎ /phyag na rin chen dpal be'u 'od 'bar ba/ /thogs nas rgyal ba'i thugs laྎ /thugs la dpal be'uྎ /shrī pañcaྎ bkra shisྎ /phyag na rin chen rgyal mtshan yid 'ong ba/ /thogs nas rgyal ba'i sku laྎ /sku la rgyal mtshanྎ /dh+wa dzaྎ bkra shisྎ /phyag na chos dung dkar po sgra dbyangs can/ /thogs nas rgyal ba'i gsung laྎ /gsung la dung giྎ /shaṅkhaྎ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni/ /phyag na gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa/ /thogs nas rgyal ba'i zhabs la mchod pa ltar/ /zhabs la 'khor lo'i bkra shis thob par shog /oṃ maṅga la tsakra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes brjod/ rgyal srid sna bdun las sngags dang / bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyis bsangs/ snying po'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ gser las legs byas lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang / /dang po sa las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i/ /'khor lo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes 'khor lo'i 'khor lo'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ dus gsum rgyal bas bskor ba'i 'khor lo 'di/ /mi khams rgyun gcod rgyu dang 'bras bu ston/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba'i dbang phyug rin po che/ /bla med 'khor lo dam pa bskor gyur cig /bdud thams cad las rgyal ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par bskor ba'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas baiḍūr+ya/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing / /dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/

dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan rin po che/ /'khor ba'i mun sel bde ba'i snying po 'byung / /dgos pa mchog sbyin nor bu phun sum tshogs/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen spyod par shog /tshe dpag tu med pa'i 'od dang ldan zhing / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rang gi gzi brjid kyi zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma/ /pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan/ /yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i/ /btsun mo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ satri rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ pha rol phyin bcu'i sems can skyobs pa'i phyir/ /shes rab gzugs mdzes btsun mo rin po che/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhi tshad med bzhi po yi/ /tshe dang longs spyod gter la spyod par shog /sems can thams cad la ting nge 'dzin zhi ba'i tshul gyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i spyod tshul yongs su dag pas bdag dang gzhan gyi don bde bas bsgrub pa la yid bzhin du sbyor ba'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig gang yang rgyal la mu tig mang pa ldan pas/ /gser sogs mang po thub la phul ba ltar/ /bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan te/ /blon po rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ pu ru ṣa rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ gang la ci dgos dpag bsam shing lta bu/ /'gro la snying brtse'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang / /dbang phyug btsun pa blon po rin po che/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal thabs thob par shog /lha'i mig rnam par dag par thob ste 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang ldan zhing rang dang gzhan gyi dgos pa mthar phyin nas shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs can ri 'dra glang po che/ /rgyal po la bos mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/ /glang po rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ hasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/

theg pa don dam bla na med pa'i mchog /yan lag bdun mdzes ku mud zla yi mdog /gdul dka' stobs chen glang po rin po che/ /khyu mchog rlabs chen stobs lnga rdzogs par shog /stobs bcu dang ldan zhing bdud bzhi'i stobs tshar bcad nas sems can thams cad theg pa chen po la 'byung nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog 'gyur ba/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong ba'i/ /rta mchog rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tu rad+ga a shwa rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ 'khor ba'i chu bo 'jigs pa bzhi las sgrol/ /brtson 'grus myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis bskyod/ /cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang rin po che/ /mi gnas ye shes yid bzhin spyod par shog /so sor yang dag par rig pa bzhis 'gro ba rnams mi gnas pa'i mya nang las 'das pa'i dbyings su thogs pa med par skyel nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong 'gyur ba'i/ /ma lus bdud dpung 'joms par byed pa ste/ /dpal dang 'byor pa'i dpung dang bcas pa yi/ /dmag dpon rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ khaṅga rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ gnod pa'i dpung 'joms brtson 'grus go bgos shing / 'jig byed skyabs byed 'gro la mi 'jigs sbyin/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i dmag dpon 'dis/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpung gis bsrung bar shog /thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i bgos pa mthar phyin nas 'jigs tshogs la blta ba'i ri bo mthon po nyi shu 'joms shing ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig de ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ji lta ba ltar/ 'dir yang khams gsum chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po chen por dbang bskur ba yin pas/ sems can gyi don rgya cher bsgrubs shig
